items.description: At WorkWave , we are committed to empowering the hardworking service professionals who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful. Through our powerful suite of software solutions, we give these business owners the tools they need to run their businesses more efficiently, increase profitability, and deliver exceptional service. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced Principal Consultant to join our Global Professional Services team. In this role, you will hold strategic and product authority for Enterprise-scale transformation programmes, acting as the deepest technical and product reference point for Timegate or TemplaCMS across EMEA. Operating as a critical senior leader within our global Professional Services organization, you will extend the team's capability through people leadership, delivery methodology ownership, and high-level advisory input to Sales, Product, and customer executives. This role demands an exceptional blend of commercial acumen, technical mastery, and executive gravitas. You will bring structure and clear vision to complex, multi-country engagements—converting early scope ambiguity into bounded, profitable delivery programmes while coaching Senior Consultants and Consultants to reach their full potential. This role is based in EMEA (UK working hours), with global reach supporting cross-regional resource sharing (including EMEA↔APAC) as required. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Enterprise Transformation Ownership: Own and govern phased, multi-country Enterprise transformation programmes, establishing formal governance, risk registers, and staged go-live plans from inception through to execution. Discovery & Blueprinting Leadership: Lead paid Discovery and Blueprinting engagements for our most complex deals, conducting current-state assessments, designing target operating models, and owning Master Services Agreement (MSA) and phased SOW structures to convert scope risk into bounded, chargeable engagements before commercial commitment. Named Product Authority: Act as the ultimate escalation point and deepest technical/product reference for Timegate or TemplaCMS in EMEA—and serve as a global reference resource across other regions under our global operating model. Lifecycle Delivery & Value Realisation: Oversee end-to-end delivery across Discover/Design, Configure/Validate/Launch, and Stabilise/Optimise—delegating execution to Senior Consultants while retaining accountability for programme outcomes, margin visibility, compliance, and long-term expansion/renewal signals. Methodology & Scope Governance: Own, evolve, and enforce delivery methodologies, templates, and the standard-vs-bespoke scope boundary for your product line, setting a clear vision for best-in-class delivery. Knowledge Capture & Team Enablement: Lead structured knowledge-capture and enablement initiatives as a standing priority so deep product expertise is shared across the practice rather than held in silos. Leadership, Coaching & Sponsorship: Flex your leadership style (directive, coaching, delegating) to fit the situation—empowering Senior Consultants and Consultants to own their decisions, intervening only when outcomes are materially at risk, and actively sponsoring career growth with stretching, individualised targets. Cross-Functional & Executive Advisory: Represent Professional Services in cross-functional forums and provide strategic advisory input to Sales (deal shaping, executive credibility), Product (field roadmap feedback), and Customer Success. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Deep Product & Domain Mastery: Unrivalled technical and functional expertise in Timegate or TemplaCMS (or equivalent enterprise Workforce Management / Contract Management ERP platforms), paired with up-to-date knowledge of sector and market trends. Enterprise Programme Track Record: Proven success owning multi-country, phased enterprise software transformations—demonstrating visible accountability for commercial outcomes including project margins, compliance, renewals, and expansion. Commercial & Scoping Acumen: Extensive experience leading paid Discovery/Blueprinting phases, structuring complex SOWs, and defining clear boundaries between standard product capability and bespoke requirements. Executive Influence & Persuasion: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence customer executives and internal stakeholders without relying on positional authority. Analytical & Predictive Decision-Making: Ability to evaluate complex, ambiguous information rapidly, using data to anticipate risks well in advance rather than firefighting. People Leadership & Mentorship: Demonstrated track record coaching, developing, and building resilience in senior delivery teams across multi-month or multi-year programme lifecycles. Cross-Functional Collaboration: A proactive, business-first mindset with experience partnering across PS, Sales, Product, and Customer Success—including navigating global, cross-border resource-sharing models (such as EMEA↔APAC). Compensation Additional Information What You Should Know About Us WorkWave, we combine the reach of a global tech leader with the agility and energy of a startup. We’re laid-back yet high-performing, customer-obsessed, and built on trust and collaboration. Whether you work remotely or in the office, you’ll join a inclusive, curious team dedicated to building best-in-class software. How We Work: Remote-First Flexibility Work From Anywhere: Join our global, remote-first community across 30+ states and 7 countries. Modern HQ & Hubs: Prefer an office environment or need a place to collaborate? Drop into regional offices or our state-of-the-art HQ at the historic Bell Works complex in Holmdel, NJ. Perks & Benefits Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, 401(k) match, 24/7 Teladoc virtual care, and 24/7 EAP support (counseling, legal, and financial guidance). Time Off: Flexible Time Off or generous PTO (role-dependent), paid holidays, and paid parental bonding leave. Growth & Learning: 24/7 access to soft-skill and technical training libraries, and strong internal mobility programs. Recognition & Community: Peer-nominated programs, regional discounts, and team volunteer opportunities. Why Join WorkWave? Award-Winning Culture: 10-time winner of NJBiz’s Best Place to Work in NJ, plus accolades from Inc. 5000, the SaaS Awards, and The Software Report. Real Impact: Your ideas matter here, and your work directly drives client success. Equal Opportunity & Belonging WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Don't check every single box? Apply anyway. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications. If you’re excited about this role and your experience aligns with our goals, we want to hear from you. Note: WorkWave uses AI tools to assist recruiters in reviewing application materials. AI supports our process, but final hiring decisions are always made by humans.

items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

Pipeline Governance & Reporting Maintain daily, end-to-end data integrity within the CRM—logging contacts, meeting outcomes, lead stages, and next actions. Industry Acumen: Sound working knowledge of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), SIL funding mechanisms, and the broader WA human services/health landscape. Clearances: Valid (or ability to immediately obtain) NDIS Worker Screening Check, National Police Clearance, and Working with Children Check (WWCC). Preferred Proven track record in a similar growth role within an NDIS registered provider, healthcare provider, or community organisation in Western Australia. An established network of active contacts among Perth-based Support Coordinators, LACs, hospital social workers, and community mental health organisations. Experience navigating complex participant matching and intake workflows within Supported Independent Living (SIL) settings. What You’ll Bring A True Hunter Mindset: Highly proactive and self-motivated, with the grit to initiate cold outreach, build pipelines from scratch, and turn conversations into committed placements. Relationship Focus: Exceptional interpersonal communication and presentation skills that build immediate credibility with industry professionals, participants, and support networks. Accountability & Commercial Rigour: Clear focus on activity metrics and KPIs, taking personal ownership of pipeline velocity, follow-up cadence, and conversion outcomes. Ethical Boundary Management: A consultative, compliant approach that balances commercial targets with participant safety, operational capacity, and strict person-centred care principles. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://wisetechglobal.com Company Description WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! Unsere Vision? Wir bauen das beste Livetrainingsangebot für Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Markt auf! Aktuell haben wir zu viele hungrige Interessenten und brauchen dringend High-Performer, die sich unsere Mission anschließen wollen. Wenn du also hungrig auf mehr bist und massiv wachsen möchtest - bewirb dich noch heute bei uns! Art der Stelle: Festanstellung, ggf. items.title: Director, Talent Acquisition
items.summary: At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you…
items.description: At NerdWallet , we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do. NerdWallet is looking for a Director of Talent Acquisition to build and lead the operating engine behind how we hire and manage recruiting capacity. You'll own the full Talent Acquisition ecosystem: strategy, operating model, team leadership, Talent Operations, systems, and metrics, turning hiring into a predictable, scalable, and data-driven capability that keeps pace with our evolving business. Talent Acquisition and Talent Operations will operate as one connected function under this role: Talent Acquisition owns hiring strategy, recruiter effectiveness, assessment quality, and business partnership, while Talent Operations powers that work through systems, workflows, coordination, dashboards, and data integrity. We're looking for an operator: someone as comfortable redesigning a recruiting funnel or standing up a new Ashby workflow as advising executives on headcount trade-offs. You bring a strong point of view, low ego, and a track record of building recruiting infrastructure (not just running what already exists), while navigating ambiguity and leading through change. This role reports to the Senior Director, HR. What you'll do: Shape NerdWallet's Talent Acquisition strategy alongside business leaders, assess and flex the operating model to match hiring demand, and own build-vs-buy decisions across in-house recruiting, contractors, RPO, and retained search. Lead capacity planning, funnel design, SLA targets, and process governance; own recruiting workflows, dashboards, and ATS requirements; drive adoption of new tools and standards across the team. Define and own the KPIs that measure Talent Acquisition (time-to-fill, pipeline health, conversion, quality of hire, and more); build dashboards and a reporting cadence that keep the business aligned. Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of recruiters, sourcers, coordinators, and Talent Operations partners; stay personally involved in a subset of critical and executive searches. Build structured interviewing and evaluation frameworks that reduce bias and improve decision quality; create playbooks and enablement that raise the bar for hiring managers and interviewers. Partner closely with HRBPs, Finance, Compensation, Legal, and business leaders on workforce planning, prioritization, and hiring decisions. Own the recruiting technology roadmap (Ashby, sourcing, reporting, and scheduling tools) and identify where AI can be a genuine force multiplier in recruiting and Talent Operations. What you'll bring: 8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, including at least 5 years leading Talent Acquisition as a function in a player/coach capacity. Experience managing an integrated Talent Acquisition and Talent Operations model. A track record of building or redesigning a recruiting operating model, including process design, capacity planning, vendor strategy, metrics, systems, and governance. Experience managing a mixed recruiting-capacity model, which may include internal teams, contractors, RPOs, and retained search firms. Experience supporting a high-growth or rapidly evolving company, scaling hiring across several hundred employees. Strong understanding of recruiting operations: ATS design, workflows, coordination models, dashboards, data integrity, and reporting, with experience establishing and enforcing SLA-based metrics. Hands-on proficiency with Ashby or a comparable modern ATS, used to drive process and decision-making, not just track candidates. Experience hiring across a broad range of levels and functions, from early-career through executive search. Experience building employer brand and talent attraction programs, including referral programs, internal mobility, and recruiting events. Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to engage, influence, and motivate diverse audiences. Comfort operating as an executive partner with a strong point of view, sound judgment, and low ego. What would make you stand out: Experience selecting, implementing, or modernizing recruiting technology and driving adoption across a team. Experience integrating AI or automation into recruiting and Talent Operations workflows. Experience building recruiting dashboards and operating reviews that directly influence business decisions. Familiarity with workforce management, contingent workforce programs, or vendor-governance models. Experience clarifying decision rights across Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, HRIS, and People Operations. Familiarity with recruiting practices across multiple regions or a distributed and remote workforce. Experience in fintech, consumer technology, or another regulated or fast-scaling consumer-facing industry. Where: This role will be remote (based in the U.S.). We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family. What we offer: Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?) Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care Mental health support Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend) Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends) Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too) Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people) 401K with 4% company match Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here . NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. NerdWallet will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and the San Francisco Fair Chance Act, which requires this notice , as well as the Los Angeles Fair Chance Act, which requires this notice . NerdWallet participates in the Department of Homeland Security U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services E-Verify program for all US locations. For more information, please see: E-Verify Participation Poster (English+Spanish/Español ) Right to Work Poster (English) / (Spanish/Español) #LI-DNI

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - USA PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes. PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape and evolve the visual identity of PlanetScale across all touchpoints. In this role, you'll be a key member of our Marketing team, translating complex technical concepts into compelling visual stories that resonate with developers and technical decision-makers. You'll craft everything from in-person event experiences to web graphics, merch designs, and creative website assets that make databases feel exciting. What's the job to be done? Visual Brand Development Design web graphics including technical diagrams, illustrations, and interactive visual assets that simplify complex database concepts. Create compelling visual systems for campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives. Design for multiple formats and contexts: digital, print, experiential, and merchandise. In-Person Experiences Design booth graphics, signage, and environmental branding for conferences, meetups, and community events. Collaborate with the events team to create memorable, on-brand experiences that stand out Design merch that developers actually want to wear and use. Create branded collateral including banners, posters, stickers, and promotional materials. Website and Digital Assets Design creative website components and landing pages. Design data visualizations and technical diagrams that make complex information accessible. Create social media graphics, blog post imagery, and other digital marketing assets. Develop templates and design systems that enable the team to move quickly. Brand Evolution Collaborate with marketing leadership to evolve and expand the PlanetScale brand identity. Explore new visual directions while maintaining brand coherence. Document design decisions and maintain brand guidelines. These attributes best describe you. A strong portfolio demonstrating versatile design skills across digital, print, and experiential design. Deep understanding of design fundamentals: typography, color, composition, and visual hierarchy. You've figured out where AI actually helps in a design workflow and built process around it. Comfortable working in both brand and production modes. You can think big picture and execute in the details. Strong communication skills with the ability to both articulate design decisions and understand direction. Self-directed and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. Collaborative spirit with the ability to incorporate feedback while maintaining creative vision. What else will help you be successful. Experience designing for technical or developer-focused brands. Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and other design tools. Comfortable using AI to build a working first draft of a page rather than handing off a static mockup. Understanding of design systems and component-based thinking. Enthusiasm for learning about databases, infrastructure, and developer tools. Why PlanetScale We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Brand Designer, you'll help shape how developers and engineering leaders perceive and interact with PlanetScale, translating the power of our platform into visual experiences that inspire and inform. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America. At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status. If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate! Total Compensation and Pay Transparency An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process. Base salary range: $170,000 - $220,000 USD To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-brand-designer

items.description: Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website ( monks.com/careers ). Senior Site Reliability Engineer About the Role As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll join a dedicated, 100% remote team working closely with a major global client in the healthcare and life sciences industry. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of public-facing services by implementing SLOs, automating toil, and managing robust observability platforms. We are looking for someone who is highly communicative, proactive, and thrives in an open, tech-centric culture. You must be comfortable taking the initiative, mentoring fellow engineers, and confidently communicating technical solutions in fluent English to both technical peers and client stakeholders. Responsibilities: Implement and maintain SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for owned services to balance reliability with feature development. Build and maintain observability across services using metrics, logs, traces, and alerting to ensure actionable signals tied to user impact. Lead capacity planning, load testing, and resilience testing for critical, public-facing services. Automate manual processes and toil to improve operational efficiency, minimize human error, and streamline CI/CD pipelines. Contribute to the platform's reliability through Terraform and Kubernetes configuration on AWS, strictly adhering to Cloud Platform standards. Participate in on-call rotations and incident management, responding with urgency, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving blameless postmortems. Mentor and guide other engineers, fostering a culture of operational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning within the team. About You The essentials: Strict geographical requirement: You must be currently residing in Costa Rica (role is 100% remote within the country). Extensive hands-on experience as a Site Reliability Engineer managing production systems, including implementing SLOs, error budgets, and incident response. Working proficiency managing infrastructure with Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS environments. Deep experience with observability platforms (such as Datadog) and designing effective, actionable alert systems. Strong scripting and programming skills (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and custom tooling. Outstanding communication skills and fluent English; you must be proactive, participate actively with your camera on, and comfortably articulate technical solutions without relying on AI-generated scripts. Not a Must but a Plus: Experience using agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, MCP-based integrations) to automate engineering or operational workflows with appropriate guardrails and human oversight. At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds who are excited to contribute to our mission. #LI-VD1#LI-Remote About Monks Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect. This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: San Francisco, US URL: https://redditinc.com/ Senior Product Adoption Strategist (Shopping) Remote - United States Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 116 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Location: NYC We’re assembling a collaborative team of individuals to drive Reddit Ads product adoption within our Global Sales organization and with advertisers. The Product Adoption team’s mission is to accelerate and scale the adoption of priority products and features to drive advertiser success and revenue growth. We are looking for our next team member who can help us to innovate and scale across our major adoption programs. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Shopping product adoption across Large Customer Sales and Mid-Market advertisers worldwide. You will partner with Sales to pitch, onboard, activate, and grow advertisers on our Shopping product solutions and activate high-priority business opportunities. building global ads product adoption programs for advertisers and agencies. Your close partners will also include Product, PMM, Strategy & Ops, Enablement, and Marketing Science. You will drive the activation of our Shopping ads products to meet our customers' performance goals. You will work directly with account teams and advertisers to pitch, onboard, and activate across our Shopping solutions. Additionally, you will advocate for advertiser Shopping product needs, opportunities, and gaps within Reddit’s R&D organization. Why Join Reddit’s Product Adoption Team? Innovative Environment: Be part of a newly reimagined team at one of the most dynamic platforms worldwide, contributing to groundbreaking strategies that drive growth. Career Advancement: Significant opportunities for career development and mobility as you help shape the future of product adoption at Reddit. Collaborative Culture: Join a group of thoughtful, smart, and adaptable individuals who value collaboration and support each other's growth. Responsibilities: Drive Growth: Lead efforts to scale the adoption of Reddit’s Shopping ads products, increasing advertiser engagement and revenue. Develop Channel Strategies: Create and implement sales strategies tailored to Shopping ads programs in support of Large Customer Sales (LCS) and Mid-Market advertisers and sales teams worldwide. Engage Clients: Work directly with advertisers to identify, pitch, activate, onboard, and grow clients with strategic product opportunities. Enable Sales: Customize enablement for sales by channel and ensure that teams have the necessary knowledge, training, collateral, and market insights to effectively position and implement Reddit's Shopping ad products. Leverage Partners: Work with 3P partners to accelerate Shopping ads growth. Foster Feedback Loop: Advocate for advertiser needs and identify opportunities and gaps, providing feedback to PMM and Product teams to inform ongoing product development. Measure results: Partner with Sales and Strategy & Operations leadership to track progress to goal and identify steps that can be taken to accelerate outcomes. Basic Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, sales, marketing strategy, operations, or relevant industries Industry Experience: A strong background in product adoption, growth, or sales strategy within the digital advertising industry. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with partner teams, leveraging cross-functional expertise to drive program success. Proficient in Google Suite and Salesforce. Passion for understanding client needs and delivering solutions that drive their success. Preferred Qualifications: Direct Shopping product and/or eCommerce experience Analytical Skills: Solid familiarity with data analysis techniques and tools such as Mode, Tableau, and Salesforce to track key metrics and outcomes. Project Management: Excellent program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives concurrently. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of clearly articulating strategies and outcomes to internal and external stakeholders. Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and will also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base pay range for this position is: $126,000 - $176,400 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-senior-product-adoption-strategist-shopping-1

items.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
items.summary: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. You'd be joining the Artificial Intelligence team . We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region (Central & Eastern Europe) or we are happy to meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis. The mission You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric. Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway. What you'll actually do Frame the problem before modelling it. Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job. Work the data at scale. Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute. Build and evaluate models across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality. Design the evaluation, not just the model. Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?" Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one. Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering. You own the model and the evidence; they own making it survive production. That handoff is a document and a conversation, not a notebook over a wall. Explain your results to people who aren't data scientists — Product, Engineering leadership, and sometimes customers. What success looks like after 12 months Two models you built are in production and you can name the business metric each one moved. A question the team was arguing about is settled, with evidence, and your writeup is what people link to. ML Engineering describes your handoffs as easy. This role bends in three directions We'd rather shape it around you than the other way round. Modelling & data science — features, experiments, and whether the number means anything. ML product engineering — you own an ML-powered feature end to end and the ML part is what makes it interesting. Platform & MLOps — pipelines, serving, deployment, observability, inference cost. Most people lean one way and dip into the others. This opening is centered on the first. If you'd rather own the serving path, latency and reliability, our Senior AI/ML Engineer opening (in Czechia or Slovakia) is the better fit, and applying to both is fine. What you'll need 5+ years building ML models that shipped and were used by someone other than you — in industry, not only in research or coursework. Strong Python and genuinely strong SQL. You should be comfortable being handed a warehouse and finding your own way around it. Solid grounding in classical ML — tree-based models, regression, classification, clustering — and the judgement to know when the simpler model is the right answer. Real rigour on experiment design and evaluation. You know why a metric moved, and when it didn't move for the reason everyone assumes. Comfort on a cloud data platform — we work in GCP (BigQuery) and Databricks, but the principles transfer. A quantitative degree, or equivalent practical depth. Working English, written and spoken. Plus real depth in at least one of: Causal inference and uplift modelling — separating who converts because of an intervention from who would have converted anyway. Contextual bandits, sequential decision-making, or off-policy evaluation. Ranking, recommendation or information retrieval. LLM evaluation, or applied work with the GenAI stack. Also good: you use agentic coding tools daily and have a view on where they help and where they quietly don't. We build agents for a living, and people who use them tend to have better instincts about them. #LI-KP1 The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Base Salary Range 1 470 000 Kč—1 830 000 Kč CZK More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

items.description: Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. Operating Principles: Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet. We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team. AI-First by Default We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate. That means more than using the tools. We expect you to: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster. Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you. Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet. Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place. We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment. The Opportunity We're building the engine that solves customer challenges at scale. When customers hit a limit in our voice AI, you'll measure it, fix it, and ship the fix to every customer in weeks. Example projects: Expanding our models to new languages and regions Improving how text-to-speech pronounces names, terms, and numbers Isolating a speaker's voice from background noise and crosstalk Giving customers early access to new voice capabilities, like steerable and cloned voices, and using their feedback to guide the research methodology Releasing new benchmarks for Voice AI use-cases The Role You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: Turning vague customer problems into clear metrics Using whatever works to fix them, including fine-tuning, new data, and external models Shipping work that customers use within weeks The Challenge We are seeking researchers who: Own a customer problem until it measurably improves in production Find the fastest path to a fix, even if it's an approach no one has tried Can tell when a result is ready for customers If these expectations energize you, you might be the person we need. This role takes focus on the customer's problem, creativity in approach, and a strong drive to ship. What You'll Do Find where our models fall short and set targets for improvement Design evaluations that show whether a model is better and why Curate and generate data and fine-tune models Build working systems quickly and ship them to production We don't require a specific degree. items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. You'd be joining the Artificial Intelligence team . We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region (Central & Eastern Europe) or we are happy to meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis. The mission You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric. Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway. What you'll actually do Frame the problem before modelling it. Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job. Work the data at scale. Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute. Build and evaluate models across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality. Design the evaluation, not just the model. Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?" Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one. Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering. You own the model and the evidence; they own making it survive production. That handoff is a document and a conversation, not a notebook over a wall. Explain your results to people who aren't data scientists — Product, Engineering leadership, and sometimes customers. What success looks like after 12 months Two models you built are in production and you can name the business metric each one moved. A question the team was arguing about is settled, with evidence, and your writeup is what people link to. ML Engineering describes your handoffs as easy. This role bends in three directions We'd rather shape it around you than the other way round. Modelling & data science — features, experiments, and whether the number means anything. ML product engineering — you own an ML-powered feature end to end and the ML part is what makes it interesting. Platform & MLOps — pipelines, serving, deployment, observability, inference cost. Most people lean one way and dip into the others. This opening is centered on the first. If you'd rather own the serving path, latency and reliability, our our Senior AI/ML Engineer opening (in Czechia or Slovakia) is the better fit, and applying to both is fine. What you'll need 5+ years building ML models that shipped and were used by someone other than you — in industry, not only in research or coursework. Strong Python and genuinely strong SQL. You should be comfortable being handed a warehouse and finding your own way around it. Solid grounding in classical ML — tree-based models, regression, classification, clustering — and the judgement to know when the simpler model is the right answer. Real rigour on experiment design and evaluation. You know why a metric moved, and when it didn't move for the reason everyone assumes. Comfort on a cloud data platform — we work in GCP (BigQuery) and Databricks, but the principles transfer. A quantitative degree, or equivalent practical depth. Working English, written and spoken. Plus real depth in at least one of: Causal inference and uplift modelling — separating who converts because of an intervention from who would have converted anyway. Contextual bandits, sequential decision-making, or off-policy evaluation. Ranking, recommendation or information retrieval. LLM evaluation, or applied work with the GenAI stack. Also good: you use agentic coding tools daily and have a view on where they help and where they quietly don't. We build agents for a living, and people who use them tend to have better instincts about them. #LI-KP1 The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Base Salary Range €50.290—€62.900 EUR More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote
