items.description: Who is Tenable ? Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! What makes Tenable such a great place to work? Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc Your Role: Lead the Portfolio Enablement & Creative team to turn technical concepts into clear, on-brand, field-ready content for the Professional Services Portfolio, including service briefs, FAQs, presentations, courseware and digital assets. The role is accountable for the narrative, creative direction and brand quality of that content, and for launching the portfolio's offerings to the field. The role carries a dual mandate: lead a small, AI-enabled creative studio, and launch the portfolio's offerings on behalf of Portfolio. That means getting GTM assets into Prime, enabling sellers, and finding new ways to market and promote the portfolio. SAMs deliver their own theatre enablement and SAM Academy is the portfolio's route to sellers, but no role currently owns or showcases the portfolio's offerings. This role fills that gap, co-delivering with technical representation from Services Architects and SMEs and in partnership with SAM Academy. Launch communications are coordinated with the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead. The ideal candidate has led creative or editorial teams, writes well, presents credibly to senior stakeholders and the field, and works with minimal supervision. Working familiarity with security and the Tenable portfolio is needed to partner with Services Architects and SMEs, who remain accountable for technical accuracy. Organization Structure: Reports to: Senior Director, Services Portfolio Direct reports: Creative Production Developer and Creative eLearning Developer (a two-person, AI-enabled studio) Your Opportunity: Portfolio Enablement & Go-to-Market Launch Portfolio Offerings: Launch new and updated offerings on behalf of Portfolio, from positioning through to presenting to the field, including monthly Prime enablement launches and partner-facing content. A launch is only complete once the GTM assets are in Prime and sellers have been enabled to use them. Other members of the team may front a launch where it makes sense. GTM Assets & Seller Enablement: Get the GTM assets for each offering into Prime, keep them current, and enable sellers to use them, through Prime enablement sessions, Prime Weekly and content built for the field. SAM Academy Partnership: Work with SAM Academy, who are the portfolio's route to sellers, to get offerings in front of sales. SAMs currently deliver their own theatre enablement and no one owns portfolio sales enablement, so this role fills that gap, co-delivering with technical representation from Services Architects and SMEs. Launch Coordination: Work with the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead, who manages communications across all Portfolio teams, so that launch plans, milestones, dependencies and messages are joined up. Marketing & Promotion Innovation: Look for new ways to market and promote the portfolio, testing formats, channels and AI-enabled approaches, and keep what works. Face and Voice of the Portfolio: Serve as the portfolio's presenter on Prime Weekly TV and in webinars, presenting service solution frameworks and customer training offerings, supported by the Senior Director and a Services Architect. Creative Direction & Brand: Set creative direction and Professional Services house style across One Tenable and Prime assets, and keep the Tier 1/2 brand consistent as new content is produced. Use outsourcing where it is the better option. Content Production & Editorial Technical Writing & Editorial: Make sure technical writing is covered for the portfolio. For now it is shared across the team, Services Architects and SMEs. This role sets editorial standards, coordinates the shared capability and signs off narrative and editorial quality on service briefs, FAQs, collateral and launch content. Briefs, FAQs & Collateral: Create and maintain service briefs, FAQs and sales collateral, and own the Professional Services collateral library and house assets. Storytelling, Presentations & Digital Content: Develop presentations, storytelling, webinars, and Articulate and digital content that make technical offerings easy for sellers and customers to understand. Language & Localization: Manage translation and localization of portfolio content for the global field. AI-Enabled Production: Run a governed, AI-enabled workflow in place of ad hoc production: SME source, AI draft, production by the Creative Production Developer, narrative and creative judgement applied by this role, SME validation, publish. Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with Services Architects, SAM Academy, Education Governance, the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead and Domain Specialists. Curricula, education standards and review gates sit with Architecture & Education and Education Governance; the Creative eLearning Developer handles SCORM and LMS publication. People Leadership & Performance Team Leadership: Lead a two-person creative studio: set priorities, coach, and unblock the team so that output is consistent and on time. Production & Adoption Metrics: Track throughput, cycle time and use of launch and enablement content, using the portfolio health dashboard, and act on what it shows. Talent Development: Foster a high-performance culture capable of adapting to rapid shifts in corporate direction, messaging and strategy, and develop the team's use of AI-enabled tools. Quality & Stakeholder Management Content Standards: Own the narrative, editorial and brand quality of all portfolio content before release. Technical accuracy is validated by SMEs and Services Architects. Stakeholder Interface: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders (Sales, SAM Academy, Product Marketing, Theatre leadership) regarding content and launch enablement requests and timelines. Risk & Dependency Management: Identify production bottlenecks and launch dependencies early, and escalate to the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead where they put launch dates at risk. What You'll Need: Experience Related Experience: 8+ years of related experience producing content, managing people and projects, and working across functions, ideally in a professional-services, training or technical-content environment. Creative Leadership: Hands-on creative or editorial leadership of a small team, with demonstrable work in writing, storytelling or content production. Technical writing experience is a strong advantage while that capability is shared. Launch & Sales Enablement Experience: Experience launching or enabling service or training offerings to a sales audience, and working with a sales-enablement function. A record of trying new approaches to promotion is valued. Delivery Lifecycle: Exposure to the full content delivery lifecycle: requirements, design, production, review and launch. Knowledge and Education Education: B.S. or M.S. in Communications, Instructional Design, Computer Science or a related field preferred. Technical Familiarity: Working familiarity with network security and vulnerability management, enough to partner with Services Architects and SMEs. Familiarity with Tenable products is preferred. Tools & Platforms: Experience with Articulate (Storyline or Rise), AI-assisted content tools and managing a content or collateral library. Data Fluency: Comfortable reading dashboards (e.g., Tableau) to follow portfolio health and production metrics. And Ideally: Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting live and on camera to the field and senior stakeholders. Autonomy: Strong initiative and the ability to work remotely, both self-directed and as part of a geographically distributed team. Agility: Ability to manage multiple concurrent launches and content requests in an agile, frequently shifting environment. #LI-Hybrid #LI-MM1 This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs. US Pay Range $114,500—$152,500 USD We’re committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable - through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. items.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Deepgram is looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the intersection between research and data: people who think deeply about what conversational data is actually composed of, what makes data valuable, and how to best leverage that. Conversational audio presents incredibly rich scientific, engineering, and infrastructure challenges that are orders of magnitude harder than working with text. Speech carries speakers, accents, dialects, emotion, overlapping talk, code-switching, domain vocabulary, and acoustic conditions that range from a quiet studio to a drive-through — all with rich context that moves the conversation. In this role you'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and data teams to answer those questions rigorously and at scale. You'll care deeply about what makes conversational data difficult, you'll characterize it, and you'll shape the strategies that turn it into model gains. This role rewards conviction, creativity in approach, and a real appetite for overturning your own assumptions when the data says otherwise. This is a hands-on, high-leverage role with unusual latitude to define an area from first principles. It reports to the VP of Data Operations. We're looking for people who: See "we've always done it this way" as a starting position to argue with, not a constraint to work around Can find the one experiment that settles a question in days rather than months Are creative about where signal hides — in metadata, in model confidence, in the failures Have the vision to take a scrappy proof-of-concept and scale it 100x Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify their own impact What You'll Own Understand and characterize our data. Build the analysis that tells us what we actually have — languages, conditions, domains, speakers, quality — and what's underrepresented. Design and build active-learning loops. Decide what's worth working on next based on where it will move performance, and make that decision systematic rather than intuitive. Think deeply about how to best leverage humans in the loop. Human attention is the scarcest input in this system. Design the workflows, tooling, and model-assisted steps that make it count. Make representative benchmarking possible. Build the curated datasets and methodology that let us make honest claims about model quality across the full diversity of real-world speech.Senior Change our minds about what data strategies actually work. Run the experiments that separate what works from what everyone assumes works. Care about data consistency, cleanliness, and organization — and about making data legible and accessible to non-technical teams, not just to the people who built the pipelines. Bring method and automation to model adaptation. Turn one-off, domain- and customer-specific model work into repeatable, documented pipelines. What We're Looking For Hands-on work on real data pipelines and model-facing problems in data science, ML, or applied research Strong Python and data tooling; comfort building analysis, scoring, and automation yourself Experience with data characterization, data selection, active learning, or similar "what should we work on next" problems Working familiarity with speech/audio or NLP models — you can reason about model output quality, confidence, and error modes A track record of turning ambiguous, messy data situations into measurable model or product improvements You build systems others run without you in the room — a reusable harness, not a one-off notebook Strong communication skills, especially translating complex findings for audiences who don't share your background An active AI-tool user. Not aspirational — tell us what you use and what you've built with it It would be great if you also had: Direct experience with ASR/TTS, audio data, or multilingual/code-switched data. Experience with ensemble labeling, pseudo-labeling, or LLM-assisted annotation. Familiarity with data provenance, PII/GDPR-aware pipelines, or model-improvement compliance. Experience building custom or fine-tuned models for specific customers or domains. Comfort working directly with research and engineering teams on shared infrastructure. Backed by prominent investors including Y Combinator, Madrona, Tiger Global, Wing VC and NVIDIA, Deepgram has raised over $215M in total funding. If you're looking to work on cutting-edge technology and make a significant impact in the AI industry, we'd love to hear from you! Deepgram is an equal opportunity employer. We want all voices and perspectives represented in our workforce. We are a curious bunch focused on collaboration and doing the right thing. We put our customers first, grow together and move quickly. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We are happy to provide accommodations for applicants who need them. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

items.description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role We are looking for a Technical Consultant to play a pivotal role in empowering our clients to maximize the value of our innovative investment management platform. You'll be a trusted advisor, driving successful implementations and fostering long-term customer relationships by leveraging your deep product knowledge and industry insights. This is an opportunity to directly impact how our clients operate, transforming their processes and enhancing their investor experience. As a Technical Consultant, you will design, develop, and deliver tailored solutions that address our clients' unique business challenges. You'll partner closely with clients across their organizations, understanding their workflows and guiding them towards more efficient and effective practices. Your expertise will be instrumental in ensuring seamless adoption, driving feature utilization, and achieving optimal business outcomes. What you’ll do Strategic Consultation: Partner with clients to understand their strategic goals, business drivers, and desired outcomes, crafting customized adoption plans that align with their objectives. Solution Delivery: Lead the design and implementation of solutions, ensuring timely execution and overcoming potential constraints to drive positive results. Training & Enablement: Develop and deliver comprehensive training programs for diverse user groups, simplifying complex technical concepts for varying levels of expertise. Technical Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert, maintaining a deep understanding of product functionality, industry best practices, and customer behaviors. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Project Management, Customer Success, Service and Support, and Product Development teams to resolve complex issues and influence product roadmap decisions. Process Optimization: Develop and implement standard operating procedures to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the Technical Consulting Team. Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain documentation on product and procedural best practices, ensuring consistent messaging across the organization. AI-Enabled Efficiency : Use AI tools to accelerate recurring work, qualify client use-cases to our product offerings, manage your client book, and prepare documentation Qualifications Minimum of 2 years of experience working with clients within the investment management industry. Proven ability to lead client-facing meetings and presentations, including executive-level audiences. Exceptional analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills (written and verbal). Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and implementing process improvements. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) productively for day-to-day work: delegating recurring tasks, iterating through multi-turn prompts, and critically evaluating output. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and thrive in a collaborative team environment. Willingness to travel nationally up to 10% as needed. Technical experience in working with API implementations is a plus Previous consulting experience helping customers achieve outcomes in a technical manner Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Compensation Compensation for this position includes a base salary, bonus, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Benefits include: Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family Life insurance Mental wellness coverage Fertility and growing family support Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies Retirement saving plans Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home Annual professional development stipend Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits. #experiencedprofessional #LI-AM #LI-Remote #Juniper-US

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation. About the role CertiK works with banks, regulators and regulated financial institutions that adopt digital assets. We build regulatory technology for these markets, and we are hiring a lead product manager to own what we build next for these clients. You will gather client needs directly and through our client-facing consultants, turn them into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and present our products to clients, prospects and regulators in North America and, when needed, abroad. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role Supabase manages millions of Postgres instances and is growing. We have strong teams across observability, release engineering, and incident management — and we're concentrating our reliability efforts into a dedicated SRE practice that ties the discipline together across the platform. You'll be embedded within Service Operations, and your primary job is to make every engineering team more reliable — not by owning their infrastructure, but by establishing the practices, frameworks, and feedback loops that let them own reliability themselves. You'll work across the org: sometimes setting the standard, sometimes pair-programming a fix, sometimes helping a team define their error budget, sometimes telling them it's exhausted. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong vision for how SRE should work and thrives in async, fast-paced environments where influence matters more than authority. What You'll Own Partner with service teams to define meaningful SLIs and SLOs grounded in customer experience, and build the error budget policies that turn them into engineering decisions Own and evolve the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process — conducting reviews for new services and major changes across observability, alerting, runbooks, capacity, and graceful degradation Strengthen the incident-to-improvement pipeline: connecting postmortem findings to operational readiness gaps, identifying repeat failure patterns, and driving systemic fixes Act as the reliability expert teams pull in for architecture reviews, failure mode analysis, dependency mapping, and resilience design Identify and quantify operational toil across the org, and build or advocate for automation that eliminates it Help teams design sustainable on-call practices: alert quality, escalation paths, runbook coverage, and noise reduction Track and report on org-wide operational maturity, surfacing systemic gaps and driving remediation You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 7+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or reliability-focused roles, including experience shaping SRE practices and driving adoption across engineering teams Have a software engineering mindset — you write code and build tools, not just configure them Have hands-on experience defining and operationalizing SLOs/SLIs at scale, including error budget policies that actually influenced engineering decisions Have deep experience with incident response, postmortem facilitation, and turning incident learnings into systemic improvements Have worked with large-scale multi-tenant systems (bonus: managed database platforms or Postgres) Are proficient with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi preferred, Terraform/CDK also acceptable) Communicate clearly and persuasively — this role requires influencing without authority across a distributed org Have experience in async or globally distributed teams Are energized by making other teams more effective rather than being the one who fixes everything Nice to Have Experience with Kubernetes-based platform operations Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, or similar observability tooling Experience building developer-facing reliability tooling (SLO dashboards, ORR frameworks, toil tracking, DORA metrics) What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

items.description: About Us With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality. Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market. At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us. Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come. Reports To Director, Solutions Engineering What You Will Be Doing In this role, you will be responsible for all technical aspects of pre-sale customer engagement including actively driving and managing technology evaluations, working as a key advisor and advocate for our products and solutions, engaging with customers virtually or in person, performing engineering site or architecture assessments, and developing recommendations to assist customers with deployment of electric vehicle charging solutions infrastructure. You will also be responsible for developing RFP/Tender responses and providing training on our products. Key focus areas also encompasses electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE), infrastructure, and the operational needs of light, medium and heavy duty fleets, including vehicle, energy management and battery storage solutions that consider the charging capabilities, dwell time, routing and scheduling of the vehicles, and integrations with 3rd party platforms. The applicant must be a critical thinker, self-motivated and able to effectively manage their time. Travel requirement: up to 50% travel across Europe, predominantly within the UK and Ireland. What You Will Bring to ChargePoint Maintain deep technical and business knowledge of electric vehicle and fleet directions and trends, and how to effectively integrate electric vehicles and charging infrastructure into fleet operations. Develop and deliver presentations to partners and customers in support of the sales process, educating potential customers on the benefits of ChargePoint solutions. Act as a technical consultant, learning and understanding customer needs and developing the right solutions; working with product management to help align product development with customer and market needs. Maintain deep technical and business knowledge of market and industry trends, and how to effectively integrate electric vehicles and charging infrastructure into client business operations. Responsible for identifying technical issues that may affect customer satisfaction and proactively work to resolve such issues. Provide both general “best practice” and customer-specific engineering recommendations for ChargePoint software feature usage, API implementations and integrations with external systems. Maintain knowledge of local electrical installation codes and relevant standards, specifically related to Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) and energy management solutions. Respond to functional and technical elements of RFPs/Tenders; assist in the development and execution of SoWs (statements of work) and other proposals. Responsible for identifying technical issues that may affect customer satisfaction and proactively work to solve such issues. Requirements Bachelor or Masters degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent Minimum 8 years of combined experience in technical sales or technical consulting Experience should include some: electrical engineering, telecommunications, information technology, software development, technical writing Excellent presentation, oral and written communication skills Strong customer facing and relationship building skill Excellent written and oral language skills Fleet vehicle operations, High Power solutions, Battery Energy Storage or large facility experience desired. Location UK- Remote We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly. ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at accommodations@chargepoint.com . ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.

items.description: Axiom, the leading provider of on‑demand legal talent globally, is seeking a senior legal counsel for an initial three‑month engagement providing parental leave cover. In this role, you will act as a key member of a commercial‑focused legal team, shaping and implementing legal strategies that support business objectives across marketing, contracting and general commercial matters. You proactively assess and manage legal risk, offering clear guidance to stakeholders and collaborating with colleagues to resolve complex issues, ensuring the organisation maintains strong governance, ethical standards and compliance across multiple jurisdictions. Responsibilities: Provide strategic legal advice across a complex multinational environment, ensuring legal guidance supports commercial objectives. Assess and manage legal risk by delivering clear, pragmatic advice and supporting leaders in high‑impact decision‑making. Advise on commercial, contracting and dispute matters using strong analytical and problem‑solving capability. Uphold governance, compliance and ethical standards while maintaining high levels of integrity and professional credibility. Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders through clear written and verbal advice and strong interpersonal engagement. Exercise sound judgment in ambiguity by applying business acumen and legal expertise to deliver confident, timely decisions. Requirements: Provide specialised legal advice across intellectual property, consumer law and general commercial matters during an initial three‑month engagement, drawing on substantial in‑house or top‑tier firm experience. Draft and negotiate complex procurement contracts and manage related disputes, including litigation strategy and resolution. Ensure compliance with Australian legal requirements while applying insight into neighbouring jurisdictions such as New Zealand. Maintain the highest standards of integrity and deliver clear, credible legal guidance to stakeholders in a fast‑moving commercial environment. Why Rejoin Axiom? Community: Reconnect with a network of forward-thinking legal professionals. Impact: Contribute to impactful work with leading global organizations. Axiomites predominately work remotely, with the exception that some clients require on-site presence. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Learn more about working at Axiom . Axiom prohibits and will not tolerate any such discrimination or harassment. We understand that many legal professionals have chosen to adopt the consultancy model, and we are happy to discuss this option with you. We offer both consultants and employees the opportunity to work with our enviable client roster. Contact us in complete confidence to find out more about opportunities to work with Axiom as an employee or consultant. Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in each stage of the recruitment process. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. As an Equity & Credit Research Expert, you will leverage your deep knowledge of financial markets, analytical methods, and sector-specific trends to provide nuanced, high-value insights that inform the development of advanced technology solutions. Scope of Work Analyze and evaluate financial statements, earnings reports, and market data for public and private companies. Deliver comprehensive equity and credit research commentary using industry-standard frameworks and methodologies. Draft and review investment theses, risk assessments, and valuation reports to support robust AI training datasets. Provide real-world examples and assess case studies relevant to equity and credit analysis scenarios. Critically assess and annotate research documents, highlighting key drivers, risks, and market catalysts. Collaborate in feedback cycles to enhance accuracy, clarity, and relevance of project deliverables. Contribute to the continuous improvement of project workflows by sharing professional insights and best practices. Preferred Qualifications Extensive background in equity and/or credit research, with proven experience in financial analysis and investment research. Strong understanding of financial modeling, credit risk evaluation, and sector-specific market trends. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity, precision, and actionable insights. Familiarity with major financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, FactSet, S&P Capital IQ). Advanced degree or relevant certification (e.g., CFA, CPA, MBA) is advantageous. Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex topics into clear, structured deliverables for technical and non-technical audiences. Experience contributing to collaborative projects and providing constructive feedback is a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company. https://kyro.ai/ WHY JOIN KYRO - Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant. - A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification. - Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how. - Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap. - Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive. - Flexibility: fully remote team. THE ROLE As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions: Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team. Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn. - Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step. - Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold. - Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking. - Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes. - Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage. - Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step. - Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions. WHAT YOU BRING - 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas - Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded - Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox - Clear, concise written communication - Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar) - Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall - Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly - Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting - Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours NICE TO HAVE - Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries - Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems - Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions - Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience COMPENSATION AND PROBATION - Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly. - Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%. - The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). - If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive base and variable pay - A fully remote role - A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target - Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative

items.description: COMPANY At 0x, our mission is to “Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely”. We deliver this to web3 builders with a delightfully simple suite of developer APIs that provide faster trading, better prices, and superior user experience. Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M+ transactions and $180B+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Our investors include Greylock Partners, Pantera Capital, and Jump Crypto. When you join 0x, you’ll become part of a veteran team of crypto builders who know the importance of code quality, team cohesion, and a culture of learning. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to work directly with our CEO across our suite of trading APIs and new product initiatives. This is a hands-on IC role on a lean product team. You’ll be deep in the data, close to customers, and working alongside engineers from concept through to launch. This suits a strategic operator with a founder mentality. You take ownership, default to action, and drive things end to end without waiting for explicit instructions. When the data is incomplete, you form a thesis and validate it with prototypes, fast experiments, and tight iterations. What you’ll do Own strategy and roadmap for your product area - an existing set of our trading APIs or a net-new initiative Form your product ideas and decisions from three independent sources, not one: What customers tell you. Have regular check-ins with them, analyze their metrics, understand their pain points and what they’re building next What customers can’t tell you. Dig into onchain and internal data to spot gaps in our performance, shifts in the competitive landscape, and emerging opportunities What you see yourself. You’re plugged into DeFi and active in trading communities. You know firsthand what works and what doesn’t Be a true partner to our engineering leads - reason through hard problems with them, weigh the tradeoffs, and decide what’s worth building Partner with GTM on positioning and driving adoption Work directly with the CEO and leadership to help shape product direction Who you are 6+ years in product , or the equivalent as a founder, GM, or trader who moved into building Shipped B2B, API, or infra products with real adoption and revenue Data-driven - you build your own Dune dashboards and dig into API performance and internal analytics in Grafana, Metabase, or similar Technically fluent - you hold your own with engineers on routing, execution quality, latency, and whatever else the problem demands DeFi-native - onchain trading, perps, dex aggregation. You’re the user you’re building for Expert AI user - you run agents, automate your workflows, and build tooling that multiplies your output You exhibit our core values: do the right thing, consistently ship, and focus on long-term impact Able to attend annual in-person team offsites around the globe Nice to have Founded a company or was an early builder at a technology startup - taking a product from zero to one CS background, or an ex-engineer who moved into product Strong experience in EVM and/or Solana ecosystems Strong understanding of financial markets Experience mentoring or up-leveling other PMs BENEFITS The base salary range for this position is USD $170,000 - $270,000 + equity + ZRX tokens + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, location, business needs, and candidate preferences between the different compensation elements. Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision/life/disability) for U.S.-based employees — 100% of base plan covered for you and dependents 401k and FSA for U.S.-based employees Monthly mobile phone bill, wellness, and pre-tax transportation expense Covered mental health benefits (included professional therapy sessions) A supportive remote environment Lunch reimbursement for all employees across the globe! Stipend for your ideal remote / WFH set-up: headphones, and any other work gear you may need 12-week paid parental leave Great office conveniently located in the SF Financial District for those in the region! Flexible vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!) 0x and its associated entities are dedicated to fostering diversity, inclusion, and belonging in its teams and workforce, and are proud to be equal opportunity employers. 0x does not make employment or hiring decisions on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex (including those who are pregnant or have given birth), sexual orientation, gender, gender expression or identity, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, national origin, immigration or citizenship status, political affiliation, or any other basis that is protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This includes not making such decisions based on the status itself, as well as any associations, perceptions, and assumptions made regarding these statuses. 0x will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a way that is consistent with San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity extends to ensuring that all applicants and employees can perform to their fullest potential, including through obtaining reasonable accommodations when necessary.

items.description: About Zuora At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models, from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings, helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue. We have led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we are building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation. The Opportunity Zuora and Workday now sell Zuora Billing and Revenue together under one Workday contract. This role makes that partnership win technically in Workday Financial Management (FINS) accounts, both net-new and existing. You will work alongside Workday and Zuora AEs, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, and you will own the technical win. In this role, you will: Own the technical win on Workday FINS opportunities: discovery, architecture, objection handling, and clear positioning of Zuora against Workday-native billing and revenue options Map the quote-to-cash and usage model end to end across Workday Revenue Management, Accounting Center, Close & Consolidate, and Services CPQ, showing where Zuora owns metering, rating, mediation, and invoice presentation and where data hands off to Workday Scope and build proofs of concept as the primary mechanism for technical proof, with a forward-deployed engineer mindset, working hands-on with APIs, events, and data integrations between Zuora and Workday tenants Design consumption and AI-driven monetization for Workday customers: prepaid drawdown, flexible commitments, and usage pricing, with the revenue recognition implications made explicit Enable Workday field teams, including FINS sellers, specialists, and consultants, through joint discovery, demos, and certification-ready technical materials Lead C-level technical presentations, translating pricing and architecture trade-offs into business value for CFOs, controllers, and CIOs Stay close to accounts post-sale to protect technical health, drive adoption, and surface share-of-wallet and suite expansion opportunities Share structured customer and field feedback with Product and Solutions teams to shape the Workday integration roadmap Support RFPs, RFIs, joint field events, and customer references as needed Travel within your territory as required About You You are a technical solutions professional who has won complex deals alongside Workday or ERP partners and can run a POC without hand-holding. You bring: 7+ years in sales engineering, presales, or solution architecture in enterprise SaaS Hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management, or with another enterprise ERP and its finance modules (Revenue, Accounting, Close, CPQ), in a partner or co-sell setting Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how it shapes billing and usage models Deep fluency in usage and consumption billing: metering, rating, mediation, prepaid drawdown, and commitment pricing Strong technical depth across REST APIs, event-driven integration, data reconciliation, and ERP-to-billing data flows The ability to troubleshoot a failing integration under pressure, not just describe the architecture Executive communication with CFOs, controllers, and CIOs, and with engineers Experience with MEDDIC or Value Selling A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in FinTech or enterprise software A strong plus: Workday Financial Management certification, or Workday Revenue Management and Accounting Center experience Experience co-selling with a platform partner’s AEs and SEs Telecom or high-volume usage experience About the Team You will sit in the Workday alliance solutions group, working with Account Executives from Zuora and Workday, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, Product, and Solutions. The group exists to win and expand Zuora + Workday Financial Management accounts with a technical story that holds up in front of controllers and CFOs. The team wants someone who goes beyond standard demos: someone who will shape the solution architecture, own the POC outcome, and help turn Workday’s customer base into durable consumption revenue for Zuora. Benefits Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. Specific offerings vary by country, but we typically provide: Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs Medical, dental, and vision insurance Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy) Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available Mental wellbeing resources and support Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process. #ZEOLife at Zuora Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants needing special assistance or accommodation during the interview process may email assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent). Compensation The OTE range for this role is $142,350 - $251,160 . OTE includes base salary and target variable compensation. A candidate’s final OTE will be determined based on factors including qualifications, relevant experience, job-related knowledge, specific skills, location and budget. The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here. Base Pay Details $109,500—$193,200 USD

items.description: A quick run-down of the job We’re looking for a Head of Finance (m/f/d) to lead and grow the finance function at LI.FI, one of the most exciting cross-chain infrastructure companies in blockchain. This is a role for someone who thrives on turning numbers into decisions: building financial models, driving planning and analysis, and helping the company steer itself based on clear, trusted data. You’ll lead an experienced finance team, partner closely with other departments to embed financial thinking across the company, and act as a sparring partner to the CFO and wider management on strategic decisions. You’ll report directly to the CFO. We offer you the chance to shape the finance function of a fast-moving blockchain company backed by some of the most respected investors and partners in the industry. Please note: This role is remote within Europe. Berlin is preferred but not a requirement. Your application will not be considered otherwise. What you’ll do Own financial planning and analysis end to end: build and maintain financial models, run forecasts, and translate them into insights that shape how the company allocates capital and prioritises bets Partner with the CFO and leadership to prepare ad-hoc analyses, business cases, and planning calculations that support strategic decisions Drive budgeting and forecasting cycles across the company, working with team leads to help them stay on budget and make smart trade-offs Build and own financial and operational KPI reporting for internal stakeholders and investors Use AI and automation to raise the bar on how finance operates, from reporting workflows to analysis and data pipelines, in close partnership with our data team Support treasury decisions, working with the team and external consultants on how to manage and deploy capital across entities and currencies Lead and grow the finance team, setting the tone for how finance partners with the rest of the company What makes a good candidate Proven experience in FP&A, with a strong track record of building financial models, running forecasts, and turning numbers into actionable recommendations Previous leadership experience, with a collaborative style and a strong focus on developing the people around you Experience applying AI and automation to finance workflows, with a track record of improving how teams operate day to day Strong analytical mind with an eye for what the numbers are actually saying and what should be done about it Excellent communication skills, able to hold your own with technical, commercial, and executive audiences Comfortable in a fast-paced, startup or scale-up environment where you’ll build structure without over-engineering it Comfortable moving between the big picture and the detail, with a hands-on approach to work Good understanding of European accounting principles, with the ability to engage effectively with tax advisors and external partners Nice to have Experience in fintech, SaaS, or B2B environments German accounting knowledge (HGB) and experience working with German tax structures German language skills Interest in or exposure to crypto, DeFi, or digital asset accounting We encourage you to apply if you feel your experience and skills equip you for this job but are not listed here! Company culture Embracing the differences Embrace your own differences Respect and welcome the unique qualities of others See others’ differences as an opportunity to grow Own it, do it Own tasks end-to-end Hold yourself to a high bar for execution Make bold decisions, and be accountable Understand your limitations and seek for help Fail forward Try - don’t be afraid to fail Learn - don’t make the same mistake twice Adapt - grow with the experience Have fun together Take the time to get to know and understand each other better Don’t take yourself too seriously and keep it light-hearted Fun should be coming from a place of love and respect What you’ll get Annual company offsites — we’ve explored Thailand, Vietnam, Morocco, and Greece together. Next stop for 2027: TBD! 30 days of PTO Flexible remote days Flexible working hours Equity participation from day 1 Entitlement to work computer (choice of equipment) An annual 1,000€ personal development budget once you have worked 6+ months (pro-rated the first year) A one-time 1,000€ remote budget to use on coworking, office setup, etc. If you join us as an independent contractor, you’re only entitled to the first five benefits of this list. Application process Setting yourself up for success starts with the application! Click here to discover valuable tips that will help you navigate our application process effectively. LI.FI is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply. Join us in our dedication to fostering a workplace that values and respects each team member’s unique contributions. Shortlisted candidates will undergo a comprehensive interview process, including a people operations interview, a take-home assignment, a meet-the-team & founder interview, and a reference check. For more information, visit our page detailing our hiring process!
