items.description: Job Type: Permanent Work Model: Remote Reference code: 133904 Primary Location: Toronto, ON All Available Locations: Toronto, ON; Calgary, AB; Edmonton, AB; Fredericton, NB Our Purpose At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians. By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters. Have many careers in one Firm. Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness. Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization. What will your typical day look like? Deloitte Insights is Deloitte’s global publishing imprint for business research and insights. We publish 400+ articles, reports, and multimedia projects annually with the goal of educating, informing, and inspiring Deloitte clients and prospective clients on the business issues that matter most to their strategic agendas. From leadership and workforce evolution, to AI and emerging technologies, to energy resilience and decarbonization, and beyond, Deloitte Insights (DI) publishes data-driven thought leadership for global C-suite and board-level executives across industries. As a global senior editor and content strategist covering technology and AI for Deloitte Insights, you’ll work with AI and tech subject matter specialists, researchers, data science and visualization professionals, designers, video strategists, and production specialists to develop research and insights projects ranging from reports and articles to infographics and videos. Your responsibilities will include: Leverage AI and technology subject matter expertise, business acumen, and editorial skills to collaborate with Deloitte business leaders, thought leaders, researchers, and marketing teams to develop and execute research and insights projects for the Deloitte global member firm network. Act as a journalist covering a global AI and technology beat, building relationships with Deloitte professionals, amplifying thought leadership, and serving as a trusted advisor on content strategy and insights opportunities. Ensure the intellectual rigor, credibility, and accuracy of published insights by evaluating data sources, methodology, claims, statistics, assumptions, and conclusions in collaboration with researchers and subject matter experts. Evaluate insights projects for novelty in the generative AI era, alignment with audience needs, and relevance to Deloitte’s expertise and business priorities to deliver differentiated client value. Serve as a storytelling strategist, determining the most effective content formats and leveraging multimedia and multimodal approaches across reports, articles, infographics, videos, and dashboards. Adapt content development support as needed, serving as a ghostwriter, editor, infographic copywriter, or scriptwriter, and applying the appropriate level of editorial intervention based on project requirements. Advise authors on messaging, audience engagement, clarity, accuracy, novelty, utility, and editorial best practices while preserving their voice and objectives. Champion business audiences by applying a deep understanding of content consumption behaviors to shape content strategy and delivery. Manage projects through the full content development lifecycle, coordinating with authors, designers, marketers, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure objectives, expectations, quality standards, and timelines are met. Edit content for factual accuracy, readability, grammar, punctuation, flow, style, and compliance with SEO and GEO best practices. Utilize generative AI in accordance with firm policies and standards to improve efficiency while maintaining human-led design, development, oversight, and quality assurance. Coach content creators on writing style, language usage, storytelling techniques, editorial standards, and Deloitte Insights production processes. Lead and contribute to storytelling innovation, quality control, and continuous process improvement initiatives. Mentor junior editors, review their work, and uphold editorial excellence and consistency across content. About the team Global Growth creates an opportunity for you to build a new perspective and see both Deloitte and our priority clients through a global lens. While collaborating with some of our most experienced leaders and talent across the organization, your voice will influence Deloitte’s strategic direction, growth, brand, and impact in the market. Your network will rapidly expand, and you will create meaningful connections and relationships globally. You will build deep institutional knowledge and gain an understanding of clients’ heart-of-business issues, and Deloitte’s offerings and solutions. Global Growth’s diverse, inclusive, and flexible culture is an opportunity for you to become a role model for agile working. Enough about us, let’s talk about you Minimum 8 years of experience in writing, editing, and copyediting content in American English (business journalism experience preferred) Bachelor’s degree (preferably in English, literature, journalism, communications, or similar) Deep experience in and familiarity with editing AI and tech articles and research reports Exceptional editing and copyediting skills, and mastery of US English grammar, conversational phrasing, and Associated Press style, and the ability to clearly and influentially explain edits to authors Exceptional writing and oral communication skills; proven ability to translate complex concepts into easily digestible terms Excellent attention to detail, laser focus on quality, and demonstrated ability to clarify a story’s main message Journalist's instinct for fact-checking and critical thinking; ability to read research with healthy skepticism, ask probing questions about data and methodology, spot logical gaps or overstatements, and ensure precision in language around statistics and research findings Outside-in orientation, considering all content projects from the perspective of the target audience and their needs/interests Versatile editing and writing skills, from writing engaging headlines and short-form web copy to developmentally editing long-form research reports on complex topics Experience with creating multimedia content Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, including the confidence to interact with and influence personnel at all levels, as well as listening skills, responsiveness, flexibility, initiative, decision-making, conflict resolution, and tact Proficiency in Microsoft Word, content management systems, and workflow and collaboration tools such as Workfront, Microsoft Teams, etc.; knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint Ability to manage multiple projects with quick turnaround times simultaneously Ability to work independently, as well as with a larger, multifunctional team Preferred: Experience working for a business news publication or in a publishing house Experience with corporate thought leadership and global, cross-industry content Experience working remotely with a global team Our DI publishing team comprises editors and copy editors, production specialists, designers, and other multimedia publishing professionals located around the world. The global senior editor will report to the DI global editor in chief in the United States. Total Rewards The salary range for this position is $104,000 - $215,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver. Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure. Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life. Be yourself, and more. We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance. You shape how we make impact. Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute. Be the leader you want to be Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader. Have as many careers as you want. We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors. The next step is yours At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan , Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative . We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis). When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly. Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We recognize that Indigenous Peoples have been the caretakers of this land since time immemorial, nurturing its resources and preserving its natural beauty. We acknowledge this land is still home to many First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples, who continue to maintain their deep connection to the land and its sacred teachings. We humbly acknowledge that we are all Treaty people, and we commit to fostering a relationship of respect, collaboration, and stewardship with Indigenous communities in our shared goal of reconciliation and environmental sustainability.

items.description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! The Manager of Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational foundation enabling Marketing to execute, measure, and scale effectively. Reporting to the Revenue Operations leader, this role serves as a key operational partner to Marketing leadership, translating go-to-market strategy into the processes, systems, data, and insights that connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue. This role owns the day-to-day mechanics of marketing operations, including lead lifecycle management and routing, marketing automation, campaign operations, attribution execution, funnel analytics, marketing data quality, and the marketing technology stack. This role will work closely with Marketing and Sales Operations to create clear visibility across the buyer journey and ensure leads and accounts move between Marketing and Sales with speed, consistency, and the right context. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between systems, data, process, and business partnership. The right person will understand that great Marketing Operations is not simply about administering marketing technology or reporting campaign results. It is about building the operating infrastructure that allows Marketing to understand what is working, invest intelligently, and create measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. Key responsibilities Funnel and lead lifecycle operations Own the operational execution of the lead and account lifecycle from initial engagement through handoff to Sales. Design lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, scoring models, and routing logic in partnership with Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Sales, then implement and maintain them Manage lead and account routing to ensure high-quality opportunities reach the appropriate BDR or seller quickly and accurately. Monitor MQL-to-Sales acceptance, meeting conversion, opportunity creation, and other key funnel transitions to identify leakage and areas for improvement. Maintain and monitor SLAs between Marketing, BDRs, and Sales, surfacing breakdowns and partnering with leaders to resolve them. Ensure funnel definitions and system logic remain consistent across Marketing and Sales platforms. Assess the cross-functional impact of marketing operations initiatives, ensuring alignment across systems, processes, and teams. Marketing automation and campaign operations Own the operational infrastructure required to execute scalable, measurable marketing campaigns. Manage marketing automation workflows, segmentation, campaign structure, audience logic, and operational QA. Partner with Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly configured, tracked, and measurable. Establish campaign governance and naming conventions that create consistent and reliable reporting. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve campaign execution speed and accuracy. Marketing analytics and funnel performance Collaborate with data analysts to create dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into funnel performance, campaign contribution, pipeline generation, conversion, velocity, and marketing effectiveness. Analyze performance across channels, campaigns, segments, products, personas, and stages of the buyer journey. Identify funnel leakage, conversion trends, engagement patterns, and opportunities to improve Marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue. Move beyond reporting activity and volume to helping Marketing leadership understand what is driving business outcomes and where performance is changing. Partner with Sales Operations to provide a connected view of the funnel from initial engagement through opportunity creation and revenue. Attribution and measurement Design and own the attribution framework: select models, define sourced vs. influenced logic, and recommend changes as the funnel and buying journey evolve Ensure campaigns, contacts, accounts, and opportunities are structured appropriately to support reliable attribution and influence reporting. Maintain data and process integrity across the systems used to measure marketing contribution. Provide Marketing leadership with visibility into sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, and campaign performance. Help distinguish between activity metrics and the measures that indicate meaningful progression toward pipeline and revenue. Marketing technology and data Manage the day-to-day effectiveness and administration of marketing-specific technology within the broader GTM technology ecosystem. Partner with Revenue Operations on technology evaluation, implementation, integration, consolidation, and governance. Maintain integrations and data flows between marketing automation platforms, Salesforce, intent and account intelligence platforms, and other marketing systems. Own the strategy for data quality, enrichment, duplication, consent, and other issues affecting the usability and reliability of marketing data. Identify opportunities to use automation and AI to improve segmentation, routing, data enrichment, campaign execution, and insight generation. Continually evaluate whether technology is creating meaningful leverage or unnecessary complexity. Account-based and intent operations Operationalize account segmentation, targeting, intent signals, and account-based programs in partnership with Marketing and Sales. Ensure intent and engagement signals are surfaced to the appropriate Sales and BDR teams in a usable and actionable way. Support workflows that connect target-account activity across Marketing and Sales. Measure engagement and progression within priority accounts and help identify signals that warrant Sales action. Partner with Sales Operations to ensure account ownership, routing, and marketing activity are aligned. Planning and marketing performance Support annual and quarterly Marketing planning with funnel analysis, historical conversion data, pipeline requirements, and scenario modeling. Partner with Revenue Operations and Marketing leadership to translate revenue goals into measurable funnel requirements. Track performance against Marketing pipeline and funnel objectives throughout the year. Support Marketing leadership in understanding where investment is producing results and where assumptions may need to change. Cross-functional partnership Serve as a trusted operational partner to Marketing leadership and the broader Marketing organization. Partner closely with Sales Operations to ensure clean handoffs, shared definitions, reliable data, and visibility across the entire Marketing-to-Sales funnel. Work with Field Enablement to ensure sellers and BDRs understand how to interpret and act on marketing-generated signals, intent, campaigns, and programs. Surface operational issues quickly and coordinate resolution across Marketing, Sales, BDR, Revenue Operations, Finance, Field Enablement, and other teams as needed. Create repeatable processes that allow marketers to spend more time building effective programs and less time navigating systems, reconciling data, or troubleshooting operational issues. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Demand Operations, or a related B2B SaaS operations role. Experience supporting complex B2B marketing and sales organizations with enterprise and/or multi-product go-to-market motions. Strong experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot, Salesforce CRM, including lifecycle management, lead and account routing, campaign architecture, and data integration. Demonstrated experience with funnel analytics, lead scoring, attribution, campaign measurement, and marketing performance reporting. Experience with intent data, account-based marketing (ABM) platforms such as 6sense and Vector, enrichment tools such as Clay and ZoomInfo, and other GTM technologies. Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with BI/reporting tools and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Strong understanding of B2B SaaS funnel metrics, including MQL conversion, Sales acceptance, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, velocity, and attribution. Ability to work across Marketing and Sales and translate the needs of both functions into scalable processes. Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance recurring operational responsibilities with larger improvement initiatives. Bias toward simplification, automation, scalability, and high-quality data. Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $100,000-120,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

items.description: About Rad AI At Rad AI, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare with artificial intelligence. Founded by a radiologist, our AI-driven solutions are revolutionizing radiology—saving time, reducing burnout, and improving patient care. With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%. Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI. Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health. Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie, and ranked by Deloitte as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. Most recently, Rad AI was named to CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list, highlighting the innovation and momentum behind our mission. If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team! Why Join Us: At Rad AI, we combine world-class radiology and AI expertise to build products that maximize radiologist productivity, expand access to high-quality care, and improve patient outcomes. Join us and help transform how radiology is practiced for patients and health systems around the world. We are looking for an Implementation Project Manager with deep experience leading software implementation projects. As Rad AI’s award-winning platform continues its rapid adoption, you will play a key role in guiding customers through successful deployments. You bring a proactive, “can do” mindset and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where adaptability and collaboration are essential. What You’ll Be Doing: Work independently to plan, monitor, and manage multiple complex customer-facing projects Lead the end-to-end delivery of Rad AI’s products to radiology practices and health systems, from kick-off to go-live and transition to support Own implementation readiness and go-live planning, coordinating testing, training, customer preparedness, cutover activities, and post-launch transition. Identify readiness gaps early and develop actionable recovery plans when milestones or commitments are at risk Maintain accurate, current project plans, milestones, forecasts, risks, decisions, and action items in established project management systems, ensuring clear ownership, timely follow-through, and reliable visibility for stakeholders Coordinate cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Integration resources, to meet project objectives and deadlines Serve as the primary client-facing contact throughout the implementation Ensure a smooth onboarding process by managing project timelines, dependencies, and communications with executive, clinical, and IT stakeholders Track and manage feature requests, ensuring clear communication, documentation, and prioritization Anticipate and actively manage project risks, dependencies, and potential delays; develop and track mitigation plans, communicate threats early, and escalate material issues with clear business impact, recommended actions, and accountable owners Proactively investigate challenges, assess root causes and business impact, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions. Exercise sound judgment within established authority and escalate decisions with clear recommendations when needed Conduct weekly status meetings with internal and external stakeholders Collaborate and coordinate with Rad AI’s product, engineering, and customer success teams for project goal setting, data integration, testing, and product feedback Provide ongoing updates to leadership throughout the project, via dashboards and reports Foster transparent, respectful, and solutions-focused partnerships with customers and internal teams, navigating competing priorities, addressing difficult conversations constructively, and driving alignment on decisions and commitments Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, documentation, and customer outcomes; proactively propose and help implement practical solutions, contribute lessons learned, and support adoption of agreed improvements. Contribute to building a world-class implementation organization that aims to exceed customer expectations with attentive, responsive, and knowledgeable service Who We’re Looking For: Bachelor’s degree or above At least 2 plus years of relevant project management, implementation management, technical project management, or similar client-facing experience, preferably within a healthcare/healthcare IT environment Strong project planning and execution skills, including timeline, scope, and risk management Prior experience or familiarity with radiology workflows and/or radiology-specific healthcare IT Prior professional consulting or healthcare software implementation experience Prior experience or familiarity with radiology workflows Prior experience or familiarity with HL7, FHIR, and EHRs Excellent people/relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to navigate challenging conversations, influence without authority, and hold stakeholders accountable respectfully Practical working knowledge of SaaS solutions, implementations, and technical concepts Eagerness to continuously learn, adapt, improve, and help others do so in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment Ability to build and maintain relationships with all functions and areas of the company to share in challenges and successes, and work collaboratively towards common goals Proficiency with project management tools Join our world-class team as we build and deploy AI solutions that empower physicians and transform patient care—making a meaningful impact on millions of lives. Driven by our mission, we prioritize transparency, inclusion, and close collaboration, bringing together exceptional people to revolutionize healthcare. If you’re passionate about driving innovation and delivering impactful healthcare solutions, we’d love to hear from you! To learn more about what it’s like to work at Rad AI, visit https://www.radai.com/life-at-rad-ai and be sure to follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date! Location Details: For roles listed as San Francisco - Onsite : This role will be based in our San Francisco office and we expect employees to work onsite four days per week. The remaining time may be worked remotely or onsite, depending on team and business needs. For roles listed as United States - Remote : This role is open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. For roles listed as San Francisco - Onsite + United States - Remote : We will prioritize candidates who can work onsite four days per week in San Francisco, while also considering remote candidates located anywhere in the United States. For US-Based Full-Time Roles, Rad AI offers a variety of benefits, including: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision & Life insurance HSA (with employer match), FSA, & DCFSA 401(k) 11 Paid Company Holidays Flexible PTO policy Annual company-wide offsite Periodic team offsites Annual equipment stipend For roles based outside the US, your recruiter can share more details At Rad AI, we value diversity and provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Please be vigilant regarding job scams. We advise all candidates to apply directly through our official careers page. Our recruiters will use email addresses with the domain @radai.com or no-reply@ashbyhq.com.

items.description: If you’ve spent the last few years in consulting, you know the work: get inside a client’s operation, find where value is leaking, and go after it. This is that job, except here you keep the clients. You keep an ongoing relationship with the clients where your engagement would normally end. You’ll run a book of Nash’s strategic and enterprise customers, four or five strategic accounts or about ten enterprise ones. When a deal is sold, a Solutions Consultant scopes and builds each deployment. Your role during onboarding is to learn the operation alongside them and take the lead once the customer is live.From there, your job is to make sure every account gets the most out of Nash, and to keep finding what would make it better. What you’ll do Learn each operation from the inside. Join during onboarding with the Solutions Consultant and Engineers, so by go-live you know how the customer runs as well as the people who built it. Find the opportunities and go after them. Every account has four kinds: Adoption: customers are engaged with the services they purchased, as well as all future releases of Nash that are applicable to their operations, including our AI Agents. Operations: better on-time performance, lower cost per delivery, fewer exceptions. Efficiency: accounts that run cleanly, with day-to-day work handled by Support instead of you. Growth: a well-run account surfaces new opportunities. You bring them to the Account Executive and Solutions Consultant to pursue. Run each account on a cadence. Quarterly adoption goals, a regular operating review with the customer’s team, and business reviews with their leadership. Spot risk early. Know the health of every account in your book, and act before a problem becomes an escalation. Work across Nash. Support handles day-to-day requests, Solutions Consultants and Engineering handle builds, and Account Executives handle the commercial side. You’re the one who knows what each account needs from all of them. Keep up with the product. Nash ships product quickly, including AI capabilities. Know what’s new before your customers ask, and bring it to them when it fits. Who you are From consulting or strategic customer work. Two or more years in strategy or operations consulting, or in strategic customer success or account management at an enterprise software company. A problem finder. You look at an operation and see where it could be better, and you structure the case for fixing it. An operator. You get things done by working with other people and following through until the job is complete. Data fluent. You’re at home in dashboards and spreadsheets, and you can pull the numbers that make your case. Fluent with AI. You already use AI tools in your daily work, and you pick up new ones quickly. Credible at every level. With executives and with the people running the operation every day. Logistics experience helps, but isn’t required. How you think matters more. How you’re measured Adoption goals for each account, set quarterly. The health of every account in your book. How efficiently each account runs. The opportunities you surface for the Account Executive and Solutions Consultant. How we hire Apply, then send a short Loom (2 to 3 minutes) on why Nash and why this role. A conversation with the hiring manager. A conversation with a Nash colleague. A case study on a real customer situation. Offer. More about Nash Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company’s own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco. What You’ll Love About Us ✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career! ✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates ✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity ✅ Flexible paid time off ✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. items.description: Who is Tenable ? Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! What makes Tenable such a great place to work? Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc Your Role: We are seeking an expert, data-driven Manager, Integrated Search & Google Media to own our paid search and Google media ecosystem while managing essential SEO and GEO strategies. In this role, you will also drive the strategy and execution across Google Ads, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads, and broader Google advertising properties. As our primary Paid Search authority, you live and breathe Google Ads, master modern AI-driven campaign structures (Performance Max, Smart Bidding, AI creatives), and stay at the forefront of search evolution. You bring a deeply curious, proactive personality and a passion for experimentation - constantly testing new ideas, interrogating performance data, and willing to try bold new approaches to stay ahead of trends. In addition to scaling our paid search and improving our ROI, you will manage critical SEO/GEO initiatives with direction and guidance from our Senior Manager, SEO/GEO and partner closely with our Performance Marketing Theater Leads - translating theater-based goals into execution-ready search strategies to generate awareness, create and capture demand that turns into pipeline, and holding accountability for regional numbers. Your Opportunity: Paid Search, Bing and Google Ecosystem End-to-End Media Management: Own the strategy, launch, optimization, and scaling of high-ROI performance campaigns across Google Search, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads, and Google Display/Discovery. AI & Platform Innovation: Master advanced ad features (Smart Bidding, auto-generated assets, AI bidding algorithms) to continually scale performance and improve audience targeting. Theater Collaboration & Numbers Accountability: Partner hand-in-hand with Performance Marketing Theater Leads to understand regional goals, revenue targets, and market considerations. Deliver actionable paid search strategies that generate pipeline and directly meet theater targets. Paid Search Experimentation & Optimization: Lead end-to-end campaign and post-click experimentation across paid search. Build structured testing frameworks to optimize ad performance, landing page experiences, and alternative lead capture mechanisms - driving continuous improvement in message alignment and conversion. Technical SEO & GEO Technical SEO & Metadata Management: Perform ongoing technical SEO optimizations, site audit reporting and prioritization, meta tag creation, and optimization to ensure high crawlability, indexability, and keyword alignment. Integrated Search Strategy, Analytics & Reporting Incremental Lift & Shared Reporting: Partner with Senior Manager, SEO/GEO on incremental lift analysis and reporting (Paid + Organic) to prove total search performance, identify cannibalization risks, and maximize incremental pipeline. Keyword & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct regular keyword tracking, reporting, and competitive insights analysis to map competitor SERP dominance, keyword gaps, and prompt share across both paid and organic environments. Tracking & Data Quality: Perform continuous UTM and URL cleanup/optimization across paid landing pages, organic pages, and tracking scripts to guarantee clean attribution, accurate reporting, and frictionless landing page experiences. What You'll Need: 5+ Years of Hands-On Experience: Proven track record managing complex, multi-region paid search and video budgets across Google Ads, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads. Google Ads / AdWords Mastery: Expert-level fluency across the Google Ads platform- Search, Video, PMax, Audience targeting, and automated bid management. Hands-On Technical SEO & GEO Capabilities: Demonstrated ability to perform technical site audits, meta tag optimizations, keyword tracking, and modern GEO/Prompt tracking across AI search platforms. Theater/Regional Business Alignment: Experience working directly with regional theater or growth leads to turn market-specific targets into conversion-driven campaign tactics with direct revenue accountability. Analytics & Attribution Expertise: Advanced skills in GA4, Google Tag Manager, dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Tableau), and multi-touch attribution modeling. AI-Forward Search Mindset: Strong understanding of how search behavior is shifting toward generative AI and how to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate copy generation, landing page strategies, and performance insights. Able to work in a hybrid/on-site capacity at our office in Columbia MD or Boston MA. This position is US-based only. May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time. And Ideally: Google Ads Certifications (Search, Video, Display) & GA4 Certification. Experience with SEO/GEO monitoring software (e.g., SEMrush, Conductor, Amplitude). Experience working in global B2B performance marketing environments with matrixed theater structures. #LI-Hybrid #LI-MM1 This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs. US Pay Range $92,500—$123,166.67 USD We’re committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable - through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. items.title: Assistant Managing Editor, National at ProPublica
items.summary: ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. Applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. While the anticipated application deadline is December 31st at 11:59 PM ET, the role may close earlier if a candidate is hired. We encourage interested applicants to apply as soon as pos
items.description: ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. Applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. While the anticipated application deadline is December 31st at 11:59 PM ET, the role may close earlier if a candidate is hired. We encourage interested applicants to apply as soon as possible. ProPublica is seeking an accomplished senior-level investigative editor to help oversee and elevate the accountability journalism produced by editors and reporters on our national staff and serve as part of ProPublica’s masthead leadership team. The assistant managing editor, national, will supervise teams of editors and reporters and, depending on the candidate, may also directly supervise one or more investigative reporters. The ideal candidate enjoys the challenge of helping editors and reporters envision the most ambitious and creative paths for their projects; deeply understands and embraces ProPublica’s accountability mission; has a facility for high-level story honing and writing; and is dedicated to helping our editors grow and develop. We’re looking for an experienced editor with sound news judgment who is equally comfortable and adept weighing in on what’s working, or not, in a long-form narrative as in a complicated, multipart investigation. This position involves juggling a variety of high-level projects, weighing in on story selection and direction, providing top-level guidance and editing, as well as working with staffers from other ProPublica teams, from data and research to video and audience. The assistant managing editor, national, will report to the managing editor of the national staff. What you would be doing: Supervising teams of national reporters and editors working on revelatory, important stories and projects. Providing support and guidance to ensure projects are conceived of and told as ambitiously and creatively as possible. Working with editors and reporters to select stories with the potential for impact, and helping them overcome reporting hurdles Editing, including identifying and fixing structural issues and elevating writing when necessary. Helping teams collaborate with researchers, data visualization reporters, engagement reporters, audience and visual staffers, and story producers. Coaching editors to stretch and develop their skills and ambitions. Serving as a champion for accountability journalism. We’re looking for someone who has: At least 10 years experience overseeing investigative and/or accountability reporting and has managed teams of reporters and editors. A track record as an editor of landing revelatory stories about abuses of power. A passion for and experience with accountability journalism. The ability to juggle many different responsibilities, meet deadlines and handle pressure while remaining calm. Exceptional organizational skills. A collaborative mindset. As a leader, you should work seamlessly with staffers throughout the newsroom. The ability to adroitly handle fast-breaking stories, monthslong reporting projects and exquisitely written narratives. This job is full time and includes benefits. We’re open to remote candidates based and authorized to work in the United States. Candidates in the New York City region will be expected to work in our office at least two days a week. We also have offices in Washington, D.C.; Atlanta; Chicago; Phoenix; and Berkeley, California. Though not currently in place, an in-person requirement could be introduced at these locations in the future. The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $250,000. This is a good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position. The final salary figure will take into account a person’s experience, accomplishment and location. ProPublica is committed to paying its staff equitably, and these ranges should not be considered career salary limits or caps. What you should send us: The most important part by far is your past work. We’d like to see examples of projects that show how you work as both a direct editor and as a top editor. Specifically: (1) Send us links to the investigative stories you directly edited that you are most proud of. These should be stories where you worked directly with a reporter to shape and guide the focus of an investigation. Don’t be shy — tell us what worked (numbers and evidence of impact welcome) and how you’d do it differently next time. Editing is about far more than moving around words. Show us how you think. (2) Send us a project or story in which you made a significant difference as a top editor. This should be where you honed the structure or narrative or where you identified missing elements necessary before publication. Let us know how your contributions elevated the work. Your resume. We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, but we will continue to consider candidates as long as the posting remains live on our site. Questions? Send an email to talent@propublica.org. No phone calls, please. We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law. We are dedicated to building an inclusive newsroom and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

items.title: Director, Government Pricing at medispend
items.summary: Role Overview Medispend’s government pricing business is growing, and this is the senior addition that allows it to scale. The Director, Government Pricing is accountable for the accuracy, compliance, and timeliness of government pricing, Medicare, and VA/federal program deliverables across our client portfolio — and for building the capability of
items.description: Role Overview Medispend’s government pricing business is growing, and this is the senior addition that allows it to scale. The Director, Government Pricing is accountable for the accuracy, compliance, and timeliness of government pricing, Medicare, and VA/federal program deliverables across our client portfolio — and for building the capability of the team that produces them. This is a hands-on role. You will personally perform the most complex calculations and historical corrections, approve client-ready output, and make the regulatory determinations behind both. You will hold approval authority alongside the Senior Director, and extending that depth across the team is a priority — we are targeting three qualified approvers within twelve months. We deliver these services as a managed service to pharmaceutical manufacturers, predominantly small and mid-size companies without the scale to build government pricing depth in house, so you will be a senior client-facing figure as well as an internal leader. Key Responsibilities: Technical execution and regulatory authority Personally perform complex calculations, variance analyses, and historical corrections across AMP, Best Price, URA, PHS/340B ceiling price, ASP, NFAMP, and FCP. Develop and approve calculation methodologies and reasonable assumptions jointly with the Senior Director, ensuring positions are defensible, documented, and consistently applied. Interpret CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program regulations and guidance — line extension, 5i versus standard AMP treatment, brand, generic and authorized generic classification, baseline AMP, prompt pay treatment, and UPPS reporting. Determine transaction eligibility and treatment across AMP, Best Price, ASP, and NFAMP, including returns, chargebacks, rebates, administrative fees, bona fide service fee exclusions, and class of trade. Own program-level positions and approve submissions for Medicare (Part B ASP reporting and certification, Part B inflation rebate, Part D Manufacturer Discount Program) and VA/FSS (65IB, NFAMP, FCP, IFF, quarterly VA sales reporting, TRICARE). Lead historical recalculation and remediation engagements end to end — scope, correction methodology, liability impact, client communication, CMS change requests, and resubmission approval. Review bona fide service fee eligibility and fair market value support, including PBM administrative fee structures, and determine their Best Price, AMP, ASP, and NFAMP implications in partnership with Legal. Monitor CMS, HRSA, and VA policy developments and translate new requirements into calculation, reporting, and system changes. Review, approval, and quality Review and approve client-ready deliverables across all programs in scope, applying consistent quality control standards and internal controls. Establish a tiered, risk-based review framework so review depth matches exposure, and maintain a documented sign-off record. Monitor CMS, VA, and client deadlines across the portfolio, resolve capacity constraints before they threaten a deadline, and investigate root cause whenever an error reaches a client. Building capability Manage, coach, and develop Government Pricing Analysts and Team Leads — setting priorities, allocating workload, and ensuring coverage across competing deadlines. Develop at least one additional qualified approver from within the team inside twelve months and develop the Medicare and federal program leads to independent ownership of their programs. Establish and maintain a documented position log of regulatory determinations, alongside methodology documentation, SOPs, and review criteria. Lead technical development, performance management, succession planning, and hiring for the team. Client partnership, commercial support, and operating performance Serve as a senior escalation point for complex client issues and disputed results, lead quarterly business reviews, and explain calculation outcomes and rebate liability exposure to client Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders in clear business terms. Support Sales and Account Management with scoping, statements of work, and level-of-effort estimates, and advise clients on Medicaid inflation penalty exposure and proposed WAC increase impacts. Establish and monitor KPIs and service-level targets — timeliness, exception and rework rates, backlog aging, and team utilization — and manage to project budgets and account-level cost to serve. Build the business case for automation and partner with IT, Product, and Development on government pricing logic, configuration, and calculation testing. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. 10+ years of pharmaceutical government pricing experience, the majority gained inside a manufacturer or in a role directly accountable for manufacturers’ reported prices and certifications. Personal, hands-on ownership of AMP, Best Price, and URA methodology and calculation — not oversight alone. This role performs the work as well as directing it. Deep expertise in the Medicaid Drug Rebate Program, PHS/340B ceiling price, and federal pricing requirements, sufficient to review and approve any calculation the team produces. A record of establishing, documenting, and defending reasonable assumptions and regulatory positions that withstood audit or client scrutiny, including multi-period historical recalculations and corrected CMS submissions. Working knowledge of Medicare Part B ASP reporting and certification, the Part D Manufacturer Discount Program, and VA FSS 65IB contracting, NFAMP, FCP, and IFF obligations. 3+ years leading analysts or technical staff, with a demonstrated record of raising people’s technical capability — not only managing workload. Experience with government pricing platforms such as iContracts, Model N, IntegriChain, EVERSANA, Vistex, or comparable solutions, and advanced Excel skills. Ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and compliance. Preferred Qualifications: Managed services, consulting, or outsourced provider experience supporting multiple pharmaceutical manufacturers. Experience in a smaller or scaling organization where process, documentation, and controls had to be built rather than inherited. Experience building a methodology or regulatory position library used by a team, and establishing KPIs, service-level targets, and quality metrics. Experience advising on line extension, 5i treatment, authorized generic relationships, class of trade, and UPPS corrections. Working knowledge of Public Law pricing compliance and Trade Agreements Act (TAA) requirements. Experience applying AI or automation tooling to regulatory research or calculation workflows, and working proficiency with SQL, Power Query, Alteryx, or comparable data tooling. What we provide: Merit-based compensation – Competitive base salary plus bonus Work from anywhere – Roles are open to candidates located anywhere in the US (United States) Unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off), including Paid Holidays and Sick Leave 401k+ Match Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance Paid Parental Leave Health and wellness perks including life & disability insurance, healthcare funding options like FSAs (Flexible Spending Accounts) and HSAs (Health Savings Account), Dependent Care, an EAP (Employee Assistance Program) program, discounts, Learning and Development Working Conditions/Physical Demands: This position is fully remote, with limited travel that may be required for occasional team meetings, training sessions, or business events. Work is performed primarily in a home-office environment using standard office equipment such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone. Employees are expected to maintain a safe, ergonomic, and confidential workspace with reliable high-speed internet access suitable for professional remote work. The role generally requires extended periods of sitting, viewing a computer screen, and communicating through written and verbal means. Occasional light physical activity (e.g., lifting materials or equipment up to 20 pounds) may be necessary. Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable laws to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. Employees working remotely must ensure their workspace meets company standards for safety, ergonomics, and data security as outlined in organizational policy. Disclaimer: This job description identifies the general duties and minimum level of skills required to perform this job. It is not intended to represent a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned. Notice for all applicants: we are seeking a permanent full-time employee, this is not a contractor position. Notice for Colorado and Washington applicants: In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, the expected annual base salary for this role is $150,000–$200,000, plus eligibility for bonus and benefits. Medispend is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. To all recruitment agencies: We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

items.description: About Ataraxis AI Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients. Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research. Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide. At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine. Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity). We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential. Responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting from sourcing through close Source creatively: competitor mapping, adjacent industries, referrals, and AI-powered tools Build the hiring engine, including interview processes, scorecards, candidate experience, and funnel and time-to-fill reporting Manage outside recruiting partners as needed and help shape how the team grows Qualifications 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, including in-house at an early-stage or high-growth startup Comfort with technical or research hiring, or a strong desire to learn it A track record of high-volume GTM hiring (e.g. account executives or field sales); healthcare, diagnostics or life sciences experience is a plus Fluency with modern recruiting and AI tools; you automate repetitive work wherever you can Speed and ownership: you move from outreach to signed offer quickly without lowering the bar Bias for action

items.description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. About the Role: We’re looking for a highly consultative Field Trainer in the California Bay Area (San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose) to lead impactful, in-person training that accelerates early clinical success with Dandy’s digital dentistry solutions. This role is field-based, with up to 85% travel nationwide , and is focused on helping dental practices adopt intraoral scanning and digital workflows with confidence. You’ll serve as a trusted clinical advisor to clinicians, operational leaders, and executive stakeholders—helping teams adopt new technology, digital workflows, improve clinical performance, and accelerate early success. This role combines clinical training expertise with operational execution and post-training insight to deliver measurable value at the intersection of training, technology, and practice growth. What You’ll Do: Training Delivery & Clinical Coaching Lead high-touch, in-person trainings to support doctors and staff in adopting intraoral scanning and digital workflows. Coach teams based on live observation, reinforcing best practices and adapting in real time to meet the practice’s goals and maturity level. Drive early case submission during training by removing blockers, reinforcing clinical urgency, and building confidence during and immediately after training. Clinical Advisory & Post-Training Analysis Partner with clinicians and practice leaders to reinforce scanning habits and support early adoption. Monitor outcomes in the first 30 days and surface targeted coaching opportunities to accelerate success. Share field insights to inform scalable resources, improve onboarding, and strengthen future trainings. Practice Readiness & Operational Alignment Assess readiness across clinical workflows, team structure, and equipment to proactively surface blockers or risks. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure the right resources, messaging, and tools are in place before training day. Customize training strategies based on practice size, complexity, and clinical goals. What We’re Looking For: Clinical Training Experience: 3+ years of experience delivering clinical training in digital dentistry or dental technology, with strong familiarity with intraoral scanning and digital workflows. Should have experience training cohorts of up to ten assistants or staff at a time Travel Readiness: Willingness and enthusiasm to travel up to 85% to deliver in-practice training and support. Proximity to Travel Hubs: Located near a major airport to support frequent national travel. Must be within 60-min drive to airport. Leadership Presence: Comfortable partnering with senior leaders, clinicians, and staff across roles to influence behavior and drive adoption. In-Person Agility : Comfortable operating independently in the field, adjusting plans in real-time based on practice dynamics and needs. Operational Expertise: 3+ years managing training logistics, readiness assessments, and multi-practice coordination in fast-paced environments. Strong Communicator: Excellent presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to adjust tone and approach based on audience—whether working with hygienists or C-suite stakeholders. Customer-Centric Mindset: Passion for helping practices succeed, with a solutions-oriented approach to onboarding, training, and adoption. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work. Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more! items.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo , the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Partnerships Team The Partnerships team sources, negotiates, and manages external relationships behind DuckDuckGo's products, from AI model and cloud infrastructure providers to distribution, content, and monetization partners. Alongside that work, the team also handles a steady stream of vendor deals for the software, tooling, and service contracts that keeps the company running. Our Need We are seeking a well-established, independent Procurement Advisor Practice to advise the partnerships team in DuckDuckGo's vendor selection, procurement and negotiations. Our procurement efforts cover a broad set of vendors including collaboration tools, AI services, SaaS, analytics and data tools, developer tooling, and professional services. We are seeking a procurement advisory practice that will provide our team with counsel on needs scoping, vendor identification, vendor conversations, price negotiations strategies and benchmarks, and guidance on proposed terms. DuckDuckGo remains responsible for our internal processes and approvals, and for signing vendor contracts. Advisory Practice Profile 10+ years advisory practice in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with a focus on software and SaaS. Your practice has provided direction on hundreds of contracts and has deep enough experience to provide clients with guidance on where the leverage usually is. Your practice has a well-established approach to commercial and contractual details -- including deep experience in providing guidance on order forms, MSAs, and DPAs terms, a time-tested methodology for vendor comparison, and proven track record of working across a client organization including with legal, security, finance, product, engineering. Your practice has sufficient capacity to advise many small deals in parallel, each with a different internal owner. Your practice has deep experience in providing deal advisory across a broad set of vendors: collaboration, recruiting, analytics, developer tooling, data and research subscriptions, professional services. Your practice has a proven track record of building trust quickly with client teams, providing clear client communications, and working asynchronously across multiple time zones in North America and Europe. Your practice care s about privacy and has experience in navigating data handling and security issues with clients and vendors. Your practice is an established business: an operating entity or registered sole proprietorship with other current clients, its own professional liability insurance, and client references available on request. Your practice is located in the US. Engagement Details We expect the scope of work to cover an estimated 3 to 5 deals per month (estimated approximately 15-20 hours per week) compensated by a fixed rate, with pricing for additional volume set out in the statement of work, starting with an initial six-month term with the option to extend. This is a business-to-business services engagement, not employment. Your practice will deliver advisory services remotely on its own schedule with working sessions scheduled by mutual agreement. Your practice will use its own equipment, tools, and methods. DuckDuckGo will provide the deal information and access to internal deal owners needed for each engagement, and limited system access where a specific deal requires it. Please note that: Your practice will be subject to DuckDuckGo's standard vendor due diligence, including privacy and security review, and must confirm that any personnel assigned to the engagement have passed a background check conducted by your practice. By submitting a proposal, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information is cause for rejection of the proposal or immediate termination of the engagement. DISCLOSURE STATEMENT: USE OF AI IN VENDOR SELECTION As part of our commitment to enhancing our vendor evaluation process, we use artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to help review and summarize proposals, flag potentially fraudulent submissions, and compare proposals against our evaluation criteria. All final selection decisions are made by DuckDuckGo personnel. Information you submit will be handled in accordance with our privacy policies. items.title: Geospatial Reasoning Specialist (Senior) – AI Trainer
items.summary: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI?
items.description: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI? We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Job title: Geospatial Reasoning Specialist – AI Trainer Employment type: Contract Workplace type: Remote Seniority level: Senior Level Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
