items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.description: About the Role Playson is a leading online gaming supplier with worldwide recognition which was founded in 2012. We offer complete gaming solutions based on the latest technologies and detailed market analysis for the leading iGaming operators. Operating with growth and scalability, we are excited to invite experienced Mathematicians to apply for the opening in the Game development squad. The chosen candidate will be collaborating with Product Owners and Mathematicians, and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s overall goals. Key Responsibilities Develop engaging game mathematics and mechanics in collaboration with Product Owners and cross-functional teams Fine-tune game mathematics and mechanics into the best possible product Perform simulations of game math to understand how it compares with the desired outcome and with other games in the portfolio Provide competitive game math analysis to reveal valuable insights Rapid prototyping of game mechanics to prove the concept Be involved in the game creation process from start to finish Collaborate with development teams, provide game math specifications Be a discussion sparring partner inside our team to help build better games Analyse risks and determine the probability of wins for player investigations Share knowledge, establish best practices, and challenge the status quo Provide analytical support, including Big Win validations, player session analysis, and RTP deviation monitoring to ensure game integrity and performance Requirements Proven track record (3+ years) of successful work as a game mathematician in online gambling Scripting skills, any programming language (Typescript, Javascript preferred) Good understanding of main programming paradigms Talent for solving abstract and highly complex math problems High attention to detail: ability to spot even small mistakes in your math models and troubleshoot them Interest in slot games both from a developer and player point of view Ability to quickly prototype rough ideas Basic understanding of HTTP client-server requests Data-driven and analytical mindset in decision-making Motivated by challenges and stretch goals Good level of spoken and written English Nice to Have Strong mathematical intuition, creativity, and curiosity Ability to look at games from the players’ point of view Practical experience with workflow management tools (Jira), collaboration software (Confluence) What we Offer Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive salary in EUR, subject to annual performance reviews Quarterly Bonuses: Benefit from a transparent and systematic quarterly bonus system Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule to accommodate your needs Remote Work Option: Choose to work remotely, providing greater flexibility and comfort Medical Insurance: Receive comprehensive medical insurance for both you and a significant other Financial Support for Life Events: We provide financial support during special life events Unlimited Paid Vacation: Enjoy unlimited paid vacation leave Unlimited Paid Sick Leave: Take unlimited paid sick leave whenever necessary Professional Development: Get reimbursement for professional development courses and training Recruitment Process HR Interview Take home assignment Technical Interview Final Interview By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy .

items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets. Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture. Position Overview: As an AI-Assisted Story Writer, you will create short, high-hook, pay-per-chapter stories for mobile readers, working hand in hand with external AI and our in-house AI story system. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. This is an ROI-driven role. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. The ideal candidate is a commercial storyteller first: someone who instinctively understands hooks, cliffhangers, revenge payoffs, romance tension, and why a reader taps "unlock" on the next chapter. You are comfortable using AI as a creative partner, you know when to trust it and when to override it, and you are energized rather than intimidated by data. Key Responsibilities: Use AI story system to write complete short stories of roughly 20,000 words, from title and logline through final chapter, delivered on schedule. Develop stories from a wide range of source material, including one-line ideas, trending topics, web novels, user-generated content, and existing hit stories. Approve story direction at each checkpoint: genre track, core reader expectation, paywall placement, and chapter-by-chapter emotional pacing. Edit and polish AI drafts so the final prose is vivid, emotionally specific, consistent in voice, and free of generic or repetitive AI patterns. Write high-impact titles, loglines, opening hooks, and paywall moments designed to drive ad clicks and reader conversion. Review testing results for every story you deliver, utilize retest reports to diagnose what underperformed, and revise promising stories that fall short of targets. Track your own story performance and apply what you learn to each new title. Stay current on trending tropes, hit stories, and reader tastes across short fiction, web novels, and short-form video drama, and bring new story ideas to the team. How Success Is Measured: Test pass rate: the share of your stories that meet or beat performance benchmarks in live testing. Return on ad spend (ROAS): how efficiently your stories turn marketing spend into reader revenue. Reader conversion: how well your opening and paywall turn readers into paying readers. Output and turnaround: consistently delivering finished, test-ready stories on schedule. Revision impact: how much your rewrites improve the results of underperforming stories. Minimum of 2 years of writing experience in commercial fiction, such as serialized fiction, web novels, Wattpad, Kindle Vella, romance publishing, short drama scripts, or a similar medium. A portfolio that shows strong commercial instincts: fast-paced plotting, emotional payoffs, and hooks that keep readers turning pages. Strong command of romance, revenge, family drama, and suspense, including popular tropes and what readers expect from them. Hands-on experience using AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a real writing workflow. Excellent editing skills and the judgment to spot and fix flat, clichéd, or illogical AI output. Comfort with a results-driven environment where performance data shapes priorities and compensation. Ability to read and act on basic performance metrics (click-through rate, conversion, ROAS). Comfortable writing young adult and adult romance and drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content. Native or near-native English writing ability for English-speaking Western readers. Strong attention to detail, self-direction, and the ability to manage multiple stories at once under deadline. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Nice to Have: Experience writing for pay-per-chapter apps or short-form video drama platforms. A track record of stories or titles with measurable commercial results (reads, rankings, sales, or conversion). Experience writing ad copy, hooks, or marketing content for fiction. Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Compensation: $3,000. This is an independent contractor (1099) position with an initial one-month term. You will bring deep engineering expertise to technical sales cycles, helping organizations integrate application security into their development workflows. Improve demos, automation, and educational content to reduce customer friction. Partner with account executives on complex sales cycles and contribute to team processes and enablement. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Albania URL: http://pavago.co Description SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies. You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) . Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy & Optimization Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis. Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance. Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data. Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates. Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO). Paid Advertising & Lead Generation Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads . Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels. Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns. Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals. Content Marketing & Website Management Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives. Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages. Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms . Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance. You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements. You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. Interview Process Initial Application Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview Recruiter Screening Client Interview Final Selection & Onboarding Spark Hire Video Interview – Required As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire . After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses. Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation. Apply Now If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you. Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results. #SEOSpecialist #DigitalMarketing #TechnicalSEO #GoogleAds #PerformanceMarketing #LeadGeneration #AEO #GEO #MarketingAutomation #RemoteMarketingJobs #RemoteJobs #LI-AG1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pavago-seo-digital-marketing-specialist

The role involves editing various types of footage, including property walkthroughs, architectural spaces, construction developments, and commercial project showcases, while maintaining a consistent and professional visual style. Create property walkthroughs, real estate promotional videos, architectural showcases, and construction project features. Apply professional editing techniques, including sequencing, transitions, pacing, music integration, and visual storytelling. Perform colour correction and colour grading to achieve a polished and consistent cinematic look. Edit and incorporate drone footage, interior and exterior shots, and other visual assets into cohesive video presentations. Adapt editing styles based on project requirements, target audiences, and creative direction. Apply AI-assisted effects, enhancements, and visual elements while ensuring the authenticity and quality of the final content. Produce videos in different formats and aspect ratios, including landscape and vertical formats for various digital platforms. Optimise video content for online marketing and social media distribution. Ensure proper audio synchronisation, sound quality, captions, and overall video presentation. Quality Control & Project Management Review all completed videos to ensure accuracy, consistency, and professional production standards before delivery. Manage multiple editing assignments and consistently meet daily production targets and deadlines. Maintain organised project files, raw footage, editing assets, and completed outputs. Implement feedback and revision requests promptly while maintaining attention to detail. Identify opportunities to improve editing workflows, turnaround times, and production efficiency. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Maintain consistency with the company's established creative direction and visual standards. Contribute creative ideas and recommendations to enhance the quality and impact of video content. Adjust editing approaches based on project requirements and client expectations. Collaborate with the team to ensure timely delivery and alignment with production objectives. Qualifications & Requirements Essential Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience in video editing or post-production. Advanced proficiency in Final Cut Pro. Must have access to a Mac computer capable of running Final Cut Pro. Strong understanding of cinematic editing, storytelling, transitions, and video composition. Demonstrated experience in colour correction and professional colour grading. Proficiency in AI-powered video production tools, particularly Higgsfield. Strong understanding of audio synchronisation, sound design, music integration, and visual aesthetics. Ability to consistently deliver 2–3 completed videos per day without compromising quality. Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently in a deadline-driven environment. Must provide at least three (3) samples of previously produced landscape videos demonstrating editing skills and creative capabilities. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience editing real estate, property marketing, architectural, or construction-related videos. Experience incorporating drone footage into professional video productions. Knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, and visual effects. Familiarity with other AI-assisted video editing and content creation tools. Experience working with real estate professionals, property developers, builders, contractors, or commercial clients. Understanding of social media video formats and digital content requirements. Required Tools & Software Final Cut Pro: Advanced video editing and post-production. Higgsfield: AI-assisted video production, enhancement, and creative effects. Colour Grading Tools: Professional colour correction and grading capabilities. Audio Editing Tools: Sound design, audio synchronisation, and music integration. Video Exporting Tools: Experience preparing videos in landscape and vertical formats. Skills & Competencies Creative Storytelling: Ability to transform raw footage into visually compelling narratives. Strong Visual Aesthetic: Excellent eye for composition, lighting, colour, and pacing. Time Management: Capable of handling multiple projects and meeting daily production targets. Adaptability: Can work across different video styles and project requirements. Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy and consistency in every finished video. Coachability: Receptive to feedback and willing to make revisions when necessary. Reliability: Demonstrates accountability, effective communication, and consistency in delivering quality work. We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Proposal Writer. As the Proposal Writer, you will play a crucial role in crafting compelling proposals that highlight our company's capabilities and expertise to potential clients. Your ability to synthesize complex information, tailor content, and communicate value propositions effectively will directly contribute to our success in securing new business opportunities. This is a 100% remote role but must reside in the central or eastern time zones. Responsibilities: Proposal Development: • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, subject matter experts, and management, to gather necessary information for proposal content. • Translate technical and business information into clear, persuasive, and client-focused language. • Minimum 3 years proposal writing experience Content Creation: • Write and edit proposal content, including executive summaries, project descriptions, methodologies, timelines, budgets, and other relevant sections. • Ensure that proposals are tailored to the specific needs and requirements of each client or project. Strategic Messaging: • Develop a deep understanding of client pain points, objectives, and industry trends to craft persuasive value propositions. • Tailor messaging to highlight the unique benefits our company offers to address client challenges. Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field. • Proven experience as a Proposal Writer or in a similar role. • Experience with facility services industry. • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills. • Excellent attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex information. • Familiarity with proposal formatting and design best practices. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). • Ability to work well under pressure and meet strict deadlines. • Strong organizational and project management skills. • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. • Familiarity with proposal software or tools is a plus. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Australia URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/ Paid Media Coordinator Are you someone who loves building relationships, spotting new opportunities, and bringing great ideas to life? We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practices. In this hands-on role, you'll manage our advertising, sponsorship, and association partnerships across international markets. From discovering new opportunities to promote Zanda and negotiating great deals to coordinating the deliverables and measuring their impact, you'll play an important part in how we grow. You'll work within our Marketing team while having the autonomy to make things happen. What You’ll Be Doing Build and own relationships with associations, publishers, media partners, agencies, and vendors across our key international markets. Identify and pursue new opportunities for advertising, sponsorships, and partnerships that increase Zanda's brand awareness and reach. Evaluate and negotiate advertising opportunities, securing competitive rates, valuable placements, and partnerships that deliver results. Coordinate campaigns from start to finish, working with internal teams and external partners to keep creative assets, approvals, tracking, and deadlines on track. Manage Programmatic Advertising across channels such as Paid Social and Display, and support opportunities in Paid Search and emerging advertising platforms. Manage campaign operations, including advertising calendars, budgets, pipelines, and vendor coordination. Track and evaluate performance, using campaign data and insights to identify what's working, recommend improvements, and maximize the value of our advertising investments. What You’ll Bring to the Team 2-3+ years of relevant experience in marketing, media, partnerships, sponsorships, or campaign management. Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, or stakeholders. Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes. Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements. Bonus Points If You Have: Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets. Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms. An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking. Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows. Who You Are A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal. Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked. Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference. Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes. Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way. Why You’ll Love Working With Us ✅ Work from Anywhere We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together. ✅ Flexibility & Autonomy We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class. ✅ Generous Paid Time Off Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work. ✅ High Trust, Results Driven We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference. ✅ Growth & Innovation You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next. ✅ Inspiring Teammates You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win. ✅ Meaningful Impact Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives. ✅ Competitive Pay We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do. About Zanda Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable. To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments. At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day: Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development. Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers. Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs. Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy . This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-performance-marketing-paid-media

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Chicago | Salt Lake City | Remote (US) Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll play a key role in driving new business growth by acquiring net-new customers for Gong Foundations. You will own and manage the full sales cycle, with 100% focus on outbound prospecting. RESPONSIBILITIES Source and manage a pipeline of net-new prospects through proactive outbound prospecting, from lead to close focused on Gong Foundations. Clearly articulate and demonstrate our value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects. Build relationships with net-new logos to drive them through the sales cycle to close Maintain weekly sales forecast and achieve new business quota quarterly. Run and implement 7 to 10 day pilot program. QUALIFICATIONS Located in the Lehi area within a commutable distance to our office, with the ability to work our hybrid schedule of 3 days/week in-office. 6 months+ of relevant new business/net-new logo closing experience for Commercial. Previous SaaS and enterprise software experience preferred. Strong previous outbound prospecting experience — you're comfortable building your own pipeline, not just working inbound leads. Demonstrated success in achieving new business sales goals (President's Club, Rep of the Year, etc.) Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Comfortable selling to VP and C-Suite executives, navigating multiple decision makers within an organization — experience selling to sales leaders specifically is a plus. PERKS & BENEFITS We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Monthly stipend to help make your work from home days more comfortable. The annual OTE for this position is $130,000 Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets. We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored. Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gong-io-commercial-account-executive

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems , the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance. AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007 . WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide . You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

items.summary: About Pendulum Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome. Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevit
items.description: About Pendulum Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome. Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome. Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale. The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list. If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading. The Opportunity We’re taking a science-backed brand into retail and growing our wholesale business, and we need a leader who gets energy from building relationships and turning plans into results. As our Director, Retail & Wholesale Revenue, you’ll be the person who knows every account inside and out, spots problems before anyone else does, and expands the business we do with our retail and wholesale partners. This is a rare chance to join early in the growth of a new channel. You’ll help shape how we run retail from day one, building the relationships, routines and reports that everything else will rest on. You’ll work side by side with senior leadership, helping to shape how our brand scales through retail and wholesale, and getting real ownership of accounts that matter to the business. Nothing here is a side project. As we grow, the scope and the opportunities will grow with you. If you want to be close to the work, see your impact in the numbers, and build a career alongside a fast-growing company, we’d love to meet you. What You’ll Do Run Day-to-Day Retail Account Management. Be the primary contact for our retail accounts, coordinating with our brokers where applicable. Support launch readiness and in-store and online execution, coordinating with Revenue Operations on item setup and purchase orders and with Supply Chain on inventory. Enable and Grow Wholesale Partners. Serve as the day-to-day contact for our wholesale (including international) partners. Look for opportunities to expand distribution, assortment, and promotional presence within existing accounts, and identify, pursue and help land new wholesale partners. Own Channel Performance. Track performance against targets, keep the reporting cadence running, and optimize the channel to meet revenue goals. Drive Promotions and Trade Programs. Build and maintain the promotional calendar, execute promotions with accounts, in coordination with Revenue Operations on pricing and promotion setup, and track results so we learn what works and do more of it. Deliver Engaging Marketing Content. Share high-performing content, creative, and messaging so partners can use it in their markets. Work with Marketing, Creative, Clinical and Regulatory on partner materials, labeling, and compliance needs. Partner on Trade and Operations Details. Work with Finance and Revenue Operations on trade spend tracking, deductions, invoicing, and reconciliation. Partner with Finance and Supply Chain on account-level demand forecasting, replenishment, and inventory planning for retail and wholesale accounts. Turn Data into Decisions. Build recurring reports on sell-through, velocity, promotional lift, and account health. Prepare materials for account reviews and give senior leadership clear, actionable recommendations. Support Our Partnership Pilots. Help senior leadership run early partnership programs by tracking deal terms, deliverables, and results. Who We’re Looking For 5 to 8 years of experience in account management, business development, or category management at a CPG, consumer health, supplements, beauty, or wellness company. Experience managing natural or specialty retail accounts, including promotions and trade spend. Strong analytical skills, with comfort in spreadsheets and retail data tools. Experience coordinating across Finance, Revenue Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Creative, Clinical and Regulatory. Excellent organization and follow-through, with attention to detail on orders, pricing, and deadlines. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build strong relationships with buyers and partners. A self-starter’s mindset: comfortable building routines from scratch and adapting quickly in a fast-moving environment. Experience working with brokers, distributors, or wholesale and international partners is a plus. Familiarity with dietary supplements and related compliance considerations is a plus. What Success Looks Like In your first three months You know each account’s pricing, promotional history, calendar, and contacts. A reliable weekly and monthly reporting routine is in place. Launch readiness tasks are on track, with clear owners and dates. In your first six months Our retail launch is executed smoothly, with issues flagged and resolved quickly. You have expanded the business we are doing with our wholesale partners through increased size and cadence of orders. The promotional calendar and trade tracking are accurate and shared with Finance and Revenue Operations. Partners are receiving regular content and updates, with progress tracked against targets. In your first twelve months You’re the trusted lead for retail and wholesale, freeing senior leadership to focus on strategy and new opportunities. Reporting and forecasting are consistent and used to make decisions. You’ve helped onboard at least one additional account or partner. Salary & Benefits $200,200-$225,000 Medical, Dental, and Vision Commuter Benefits Life & STD Insurance Company match on 401 (k) Flexible Time Off (FTO) Equity We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: About Pendulum Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome. Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome. Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale. The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list. If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading. The Opportunity Partnerships with companies in complementary spaces, like telehealth and wearables, alongside relationships with retail and other wholesale partners, are the next chapter of the Pendulum story, and we’re looking for the leader who will write it. We’ve built a science-backed brand and grown it fast by going direct to consumers and healthcare practitioners. Now we’re taking Pendulum to the places where people shop for their health: through partners, in stores, and across borders. There is no inherited playbook. You will build it. As our VP, B2B Revenue, you will own every channel where Pendulum reaches customers through someone else’s shelf, site, or audience. You’ll create a partnership engine that builds the brand while driving revenue, lead our first major retail launch from first buyer conversation to full shelf, grow our wholesale partners, and decide where we play next and how we win there. You’ll build and lead the team that makes it happen. This role is for someone who wants real ownership. You’ll have a seat at the leadership table, direct access to the people making company-wide decisions, and the freedom to move fast. Your work will show up in the numbers within months, not years. If you’ve ever wanted to build a business inside a business, with a product people believe in, real science behind it, and momentum already on your side, this is that opportunity. What You’ll Do Build a Partnerships Engine. Create and run a partnership pipeline that builds the brand and drives revenue. Start with focused pilots, structure the right deals (affiliate and rev-share, bundles, co-branded programs), and build a staged roadmap toward larger partners, using early wins as proof points. Define which partners are worth pursuing, and which aren’t. Lead our Grocery/Retail Launch and drive performance. Own planning and execution of our grocery channels and retail launches, from buyer alignment and inventory readiness to in-store and online activation, and make sure we launch strong. Own velocity, promotional planning, trade spend, pricing, and forecasting for our retail accounts, and manage the retail P&L in partnership with Finance and Supply Chain. Grow Existing and New Wholesale Accounts. Build relationships with our wholesale partners who sell Pendulum on their sites and to their audiences, including internationally. Set targets, build joint growth plans, and turn wholesale into incremental revenue by sharing the content, creative, and messaging that perform best for us. Chart Our Expansion Path. Evaluate and prioritize the next opportunities across natural, specialty, and beauty and wellness, define the entry sequence and economics, and lead us into the accounts we choose. Decide when to use brokers and distributors, and manage them. Build Channel Infrastructure. Partner with Revenue Operations, Customer Care, Data, Finance, and Supply Chain to build the reporting, forecasting, pricing governance, and operating rhythm that let our channels scale. Keep Our Channels in Harmony. Work with the Healthcare Revenue and Ecommerce/DTC leaders to align pricing, promotions, and messaging so every channel strengthens the others. Partner Across the Business. Work with Marketing, Creative, Regulatory/ Clinical/ Legal, and Product on launch assets, claims, and compliance, including labeling and regulatory needs for sales. Lead and Build the Team. Lead and develop the Director, Retail & Wholesale Revenue, hire future team members, and decide how the team should grow as the channels scale. Who We’re Looking For 10+ years of commercial leadership experience in CPG, consumer health, supplements, beauty, or wellness, with significant experience in partnerships, retail and wholesale channels. A track record of launching and scaling brands with national or regional natural and specialty retailers, and building strong buyer relationships. Strong command of trade spend, promotional planning, pricing, and channel P&L. Experience using syndicated and retailer data to diagnose velocity and make decisions. Experience negotiating and structuring commercial deals, ideally including distribution or partnership agreements. Experience managing brokers, distributors, or wholesale partners, ideally including international partners. A proven record of building and leading small, entrepreneurial commercial teams: hiring strong talent, setting strategy, and rolling up your sleeves in a resource-constrained, fast-moving environment. Strong quantitative orientation and clear communication, with good judgment about where to focus when everything feels urgent. Experience with dietary supplements and the claims and regulatory considerations that come with them is a plus. Experience building a function from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage company is a plus. Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive long-term value and deepen client relationships while also developing new relationships within the accounts. Leverage existing client relationships to identify, target, and secure new opportunities within the accounts. Provide outstanding customer service and ensure satisfaction by addressing client issues proactively. New Business Development: Leverage an extensive professional network to identify, target, and secure new logos. Actively prospect through cold calling, networking, social selling, and partner collaboration. Lead discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and position New Era’s solutions effectively. Strategic Partner Collaboration: Develop and maintain strong relationships with strategic partners, especially Microsoft and Cisco to create and execute joint campaigns and identify opportunities. Collaborate with partner teams to drive pipeline growth and maximize mutual value. Sales Execution: Present solutions to Director, VP, and C-level decision-makers with confidence and clarity. Prepare and deliver compelling proposals tailored to client needs while adhering to company standards. Meet and exceed individual and team sales quotas and revenue targets. Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline, and activities in CRM (HubSpot). Represent New Era at trade shows, trade association and client meetings to promote products/solutions/services. Deliver outstanding customer support and service to all customers. Market and Industry Expertise: Stay current with industry trends, competitive landscape, and advancements in technologies that encompass all of our services. Understand and articulate New Era’s value proposition across verticals and solutions. - Digital Transformation - - Application services - AI/Contact Center - Cloud/Data - Modern Workspace and Infrastructure - - Networking - Unified Communications - Audio/Video - Managed Services - End to end security - High end cyber security - Physical security Competencies: Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth in complex, solution-based sales environments. Exceptional ability to build and maintain relationships with enterprise-level clients and partners, particularly at the executive level. Strong understanding of digital transformation, modern workspace and infrastructure, and end to end security solutions. Effective communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value. Ability to learn, understand and communicate New Era’s technology offerings. High proficiency with CRM tools (HubSpot) and the Microsoft Office Suite. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple accounts and tasks. Self-motivated, results-driven, and adaptable to changing business priorities. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). items.description: Description Reliance Worldwide Corporation (RWC) Plumbing Matters. We make it better. Our innovative products, built on a tradition of excellence, serve markets across plumbing, heating and construction to make our customers’ lives easier, while sustainably delivering unrivalled returns. We are publicly listed on the Australian stock exchange (ASX) with global headquarters in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, regional headquarters in Brisbane, Australia and London, UK. Our global family of trusted brands are committed to making a positive, lasting impact – we are better for our planet and better for our people. We operate in 45 facilities across 20 countries. We’re acquisitive and we’re laser focused on growth. Our Culture We’re big enough to make a difference and small enough for each one of us to make an impact. Whilst we operate on a global scale, we understand the importance of local markets by focusing on the needs of those markets. Our culture encourages our people to think differently, challenge the status quo and shape the world around us. Our values SPIRIT drive how we work together with a focus on Safety, Passion, Integrity, Reliability, and innovation, together as one global team. We have something special here – not just what we do, but who we are. We’re not afraid to try new things; we punch above our weight; and we move with speed. Our strategy ensures we provide a safe environment for our people, and we actively promote diversity and inclusion. We are dedicated to sustainable practices and making a positive contribution to the community we serve. Everyone at RWC makes a valuable contribution to our business. Sound like somewhere you can see yourself. Read on. Requirements JOB PURPOSE The Domestic Business Development Manager is responsible for driving significant and sustainable growth within the domestic plumbing sector. This role will focus on identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities across the New Build, RMI (Repair, Maintenance & Improvement), and Social Housing markets. The successful candidate will proactively expand the company’s market share by building strategic partnerships, launching targeted sales initiatives, and positioning the company as the supplier of choice for innovative plumbing solutions. Development Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify emerging trends, customer needs, and untapped segments. Develop and execute a robust business development strategy to penetrate new markets and grow share in existing ones. Lead the creation and implementation of go-to-market plans for new products and services. New Business Acquisition: Generate and qualify high-potential leads through networking, industry events, and proactive outreach. Build and nurture a strong pipeline of opportunities, ensuring consistent conversion to new accounts. Negotiate and close high-value deals with key decision-makers in target sectors. Relationship Management: o Support and co-own execution of (growth) initiatives with national Key Accounts (Retail and Wholesale) and Independent wholesale distributors. Establish and maintain influential relationships with developers, contractors, merchants, and social housing providers. Act as a trusted advisor, understanding client challenges and positioning tailored solutions to meet their needs. Deliver exceptional customer service to drive loyalty and long-term partnerships. Sales Performance & Reporting: Consistently achieve and exceed ambitious sales targets and KPIs. Provide accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and market intelligence to senior leadership. Analyse sales data to identify growth opportunities and address performance gaps. Brand & Product Promotion: Champion the company’s product portfolio through compelling presentations, demonstrations, and promotional campaigns. Organize and participate in industry exhibitions, trade shows, and customer events to raise brand awareness. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with Marketing, Product Development, and Operations to ensure alignment of business development initiatives. Provide feedback on market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to inform product innovation and strategy. Continuous Improvement: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory changes, and best practices. Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in business development activities. Required Skills & Experience Proven track record of delivering new business growth in B2B sales, ideally within the plumbing, building products, or construction sector. Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills. Demonstrated ability to build and manage a high-value sales pipeline. Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Results-driven, self-motivated, and resilient. Proficient in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and market trends. Qualifications Experience in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field. Evidence of ongoing professional development is desirable. Competencies & Behaviours Strategic thinker with a growth mindset. Tenacious, proactive, and adaptable. Collaborative team player who can also work independently. High integrity and professionalism. Additional Information Regular travel required to customer sites, industry events, and company offices. Full UK driving license required.

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives cus
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes. We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer. What You'll Do: Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it What You'll Bring: 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable This Role is a Great Fit If: You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you! At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $204,000 - $275,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-staff-data-scientist
