Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outco
items.description: About Empower Community Care Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve. Position Summary The Implementation Support Specialist provides cross-model implementation, operational, and customer success support for Functional Family Therapy (FFT), Multisystemic Therapy (MST), and Brief Strategic Family Therapy (BSFT). This position leads assigned provider organizations through onboarding and launch and continues to provide support alongside clinical model staff to ensure sustainability, fidelity, and customer success. The Specialist coordinates implementation plans, workforce and referral readiness, technical assistance, project milestones, program monitoring, and partner relationships. The position works collaboratively with EBP model teams, which retain responsibility for model-specific clinical consultation, fidelity coaching, certification, and clinical decision-making. Key Responsibilities Onboarding and Launch Provider Onboarding: Lead assigned providers through onboarding, workforce readiness, launch preparation, and early operations for FFT, MST, and BSFT. Planning and Project Management: Develop and maintain implementation roadmaps, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and launch-readiness documentation, and coordinate project management and technical assistance to keep launches on time, in scope, and responsive to emerging barriers. Workforce Planning: Collaborate with recruiting and provider leadership to support staffing plans, candidate sourcing needs, role readiness, and workforce preparation for launch. Readiness Assessment: Assess readiness related to leadership, staffing, training, service capacity, operational infrastructure, and stakeholder engagement. Referral and Access: Design and strengthen referral and access processes so appropriate populations can reach available program capacity. Organizational Change: Support operational and organizational change required to adopt new practices and reduce implementation drift. Launch Coordination: Coordinate launch logistics with EBP clinical technical assistance teams while maintaining clear boundaries between operational implementation support and model-specific clinical responsibilities. Documentation and Escalation: Document decisions, risks, action items, and progress; promptly elevate barriers requiring leadership or model-specific expertise. Sustainability and Customer Success Partner Relationships: Maintain ongoing relationships with assigned provider organizations through proactive check-ins, account health monitoring, responsive support, and escalation management. Program Monitoring: Monitor staffing stability, referrals, caseloads, utilization, access, financial sustainability, fidelity indicators, outcomes, and other applicable measures, and identify early warning signals related to vacancies, turnover, capacity, referral volume, access barriers, reimbursement, budget pressures, or renewal risk. Risk Response: Lead the operational response to implementation risks and coordinate joint problem-solving with EBP clinical leadership when clinical or fidelity action is required, including workforce retention, referral pathway troubleshooting, implementation improvement plans, and other actions that strengthen program viability. Renewal and Expansion: Coordinate renewal and expansion support, identify opportunities to connect partners with other appropriate organizational offerings, and promote partner satisfaction, retention, high-quality service delivery, and long-term program sustainability. Reporting and Records: Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and status updates that communicate implementation progress, account health, risks, and outcomes; maintain accurate records and provide regular updates to the Director of EBP Implementation. Cross-Functional Responsibilities Stakeholder Relationships: Build collaborative relationships with provider leaders, supervisors, clinicians, funders, referral sources, and community stakeholders while maintaining clear expectations and shared accountability. Facilitation and Training: Facilitate provider and stakeholder training and/or meetings, including provider implementation training on best practices, timelines, and expectations for successful implementation, with agenda development, documentation, decision-making, and follow-up. Data-Informed Decisions: Use data to guide implementation decisions, monitor readiness and program health, and support continuous quality improvement. Portfolio Management: Manage multiple programs, priorities, deadlines, and special projects across the EBP portfolio, and participate in EBP initiatives as assigned. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in behavioral health, social work, psychology, public health, human services, business, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience: At least three (3) years of relevant experience in program implementation, project management, provider support, customer success, behavioral health, or human services, including demonstrated experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, monitoring program performance, and supporting implementation from launch through sustainability. Core Skills: Strong implementation, project coordination, organization, and time-management skills; excellent written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and relationship-management skills. Change and Data Skills: Ability to support organizational change, resolve operational barriers, and maintain accountability through a collaborative approach; ability to interpret program and account-health data, identify risks, and translate findings into action. Judgment and Independence: Sound judgment regarding when to act directly and when to engage clinical, model-specific, funding, recruiting, or leadership partners; ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and provide reliable follow-through. Technology: Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Work Requirements: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States, reside in the United States, work Eastern Time business hours, and be able to travel up to 50% of the time. Preferred Skills & Experience Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in one of the fields above or a related field. EBP Experience: Experience with evidence-based or evidence-informed programs, including FFT, MST, BSFT, or another structured evidence-based practice. Subject Knowledge: Knowledge of evidence-based practices, behavioral health, human services, customer success, or implementation science. Additional Requirements Background Check: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower’s standard hiring practices. Confidentiality: This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and/or clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower’s internal data governance and confidentiality policies. Work Environment: This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of up to approximately 50% of the time for in-person provider onboarding, meetings, leadership offsites, or site visits. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA. Other Duties: This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. $75,000 – $90,000 per year Annual base salary; placement within the range is based on experience, skills, and internal equity. Benefits Empower Community Care offers a competitive total-rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; and life insurance. Equal Employment Opportunity Empower Community Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

items.description: Job Title: E-commerce Data & Catalog Specialist Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities: Manage, structure, and curate large-scale e-commerce product catalogs, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across platforms. Develop, implement, and refine product taxonomy frameworks to simulate real-world e-commerce classifications and browsing experiences. Collaborate with AI development teams to define data needs and optimize catalog structures for scalable AI training. Ensure strict adherence to data quality, integrity, and normalization standards within SQL and NoSQL environments. Document workflows, taxonomies, and metadata structures with clear, concise written communication. Required Skills and Qualifications: Demonstrated experience in product catalog management and e-commerce merchandising operations. Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL database concepts, schema design, and product data modeling. Strong command of product taxonomy development, categorization, and data normalization methods. Deep understanding of structured dataset management, including large and complex e-commerce catalogs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and communicate technical concepts clearly. Experience building data-driven shopping experiences and simulating consumer journeys. High attention to detail and a collaborative mindset for working with cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications: Previous involvement with AI, machine learning, or data annotation projects. Experience with scalable catalog schema design for diverse online marketplaces. Background in creating advanced metadata structures or contributing to AI training initiatives. Additional Info: This is an AI training-focused role. You'll play a key part in constructing realistic, data-rich e-commerce environments to improve AI model understanding and performance. Join our customer's team to help shape the future of intelligent shopping experiences. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The OpportunityAs a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Tirana, Remote, Albania URL: http://capslock.global CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions. At CapsLock , people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success. ﻿Role overview Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly. You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow. If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process. Responsibilities Task & Pipeline Management Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system). Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed Quality Control Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals Reporting & Documentation Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards Process Improvement & AI Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes Creative Collaboration Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time Must-Have Skills Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content Technical Skills 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher Soft Skills Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines Clear, professional communicator Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas What we offer Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact. Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet. Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more. Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience. Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program. Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-marketing-project-coordinator

items.title: Agile Program Manager
items.summary: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time. This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives. Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning. Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options. Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value. Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable. What You Bring 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments. Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release. Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar). Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting. Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation. Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike. Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones. Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves. Nice to Have Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile. Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization. Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery. Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management. Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements. Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners. Please mention the word **PHENOMENALLY** and tag RMTMwLjEzMS41NS4yNDA= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTMwLjEzMS41NS4yNDA=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Category Manager Asian & Tribal Arts
items.summary: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by…
items.description: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us. Taking ownership and driving impact Being open to change and feedback Being passionate about our mission and our customers. Asian & Tribal is one of the most culturally rich and commercially complex categories within Collectables. It spans Asian Art, Tribal & Ethnographic Art, and related subcategories where heritage, craftsmanship, provenance, and collector trust are critical. The category attracts a diverse global buyer base ranging from emerging collectors to highly specialised, repeat buyers, and requires strong judgement, commercial sharpness, and leadership to balance growth with quality. This is an opportunity to lead an established category with real depth, a strong expert team and clear headroom for growth. You will set the commercial direction, turn opportunity into focused execution and build a category that grows in both scale and quality. It is not a role for maintaining the status quo: you will make choices, create momentum and take ownership of the outcomes. As Category Manager, you own the category strategy and commercial performance. You lead and develop an international team of Experts, build strong external networks with sellers and institutions, and ensure a high-quality buyer experience that reinforces trust and repeat engagement. This role is based in the Netherlands with a hybrid setup. You are expected to work from the Amsterdam office two days per week to collaborate closely with other Category Managers, Commercial teams, and key stakeholders. The Opportunity Shape a clear growth plan for a category with global reach, cultural credibility and significant untapped commercial potential. Improve the category mix, auction performance and seller portfolio - choosing where to invest, what to stop and how to turn insight into measurable action. Build a stronger, more repeatable pipeline of high-quality sellers alongside Sales and Business Development, while representing Catawiki credibly in the market. Create a high-performing, engaged team that combines specialist expertise with commercial ownership, pace and accountability. What You’ll Do Build, own and execute the strategic growth plan for Asian & Tribal. Set a clear ambition, identify the few growth bets that matter most and translate them into practical, time-bound execution. Own the category P&L and commercial outcomes. Use data to make firm calls on where to invest, improve or stop - balancing growth, margin, quality and operational stability. Steer the full auction-performance funnel: supply quality and mix, curation pace, pricing and reserve-price strategy, sell-through, cancellation and buyer experience. Shape auction planning around seasonality, market dynamics, collector behaviour and seller portfolios, with a focus on increasing repeatable high-quality supply and long-term buyer trust. Work closely with Sales and Business Development to build and convert a stronger seller pipeline. Develop your own external network and represent Catawiki with credibility among sellers, dealers, institutions and professional networks. Lead, coach and develop an international team of Experts. Set clear expectations, create ownership and follow through on performance, development and accountability. Create focus and pace in a complex environment. Prioritise clearly, make decisions with imperfect information and address resistance or underperformance directly and constructively. Influence Marketing, Operations, Product, Commercial and other Category teams to unlock growth opportunities. Build alignment where it helps execution, but do not wait for consensus to move the business forward. Stay close to global Asian & Tribal market trends, pricing dynamics, collector demand and competitive movements, turning relevant insight into action. What You’ll Bring A strong commercial track record in category management, marketplace, retail, sales or another complex, customer-led business. You have owned meaningful commercial outcomes, not only supported them. Experience building and executing a growth strategy, including planning, budgeting, pricing and P&L management. You can explain the commercial logic behind your decisions and measure whether they worked. A data-led, action-oriented approach. You can move from dashboards and ambiguous signals to a clear diagnosis, a prioritised plan and accountable follow-through. Proven people-leadership experience. You know how to coach specialists, set a high bar, create engagement and handle difficult performance conversations when needed. Commercial curiosity and entrepreneurial energy. You actively look for opportunities, test assumptions and keep learning - particularly where the market or customer behaviour is changing. Decisiveness and resilience in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. You are comfortable making trade-offs, defending a point of view and adapting when evidence says the approach needs to change. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. You can influence across seniority levels and functions, communicate concisely and bring people with you through change. A hands-on mindset balanced with strategic thinking. You are willing to get close to the detail when needed, while building systems and capability that allow the team to scale. Comfort working with Google Suite or similar tools. Interest or background in Asian Art, Tribal Art or Collectables is a plus. Deep expertise can grow on the job; commercial leadership, judgement and the ability to build trust are essential. What Success Looks Like A focused, credible category growth plan is in motion, with clear priorities, owners, milestones and leading indicators. The team understands what good looks like and works with greater clarity, ownership and commercial pace. Auction quality and commercial discipline are more consistent, with deliberate choices on supply mix, pricing and reserve-price strategy. A stronger pipeline of repeat, high-quality sellers is being built with Commercial partners and through your own market network. Stakeholders experience you as a clear, constructive business owner who moves decisions into action and communicates progress honestly. Where You’ll Be This is a hybrid role based in the Netherlands. You will work from the Amsterdam office at least two days per week to collaborate with fellow Category Managers, Commercial teams, and key stakeholders. What We Offer A category with cultural depth, global reach, and significant commercial potential. You will have real ownership, the space to shape strategy and execution, and the opportunity to lead and develop a strong expert team. You will work alongside ambitious international colleagues in a collaborative environment with clear expectations, strong development opportunities, and a focus on sustainable growth. Why You'll Love Working with Us Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business. Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression. A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work. Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location. Our Offices and Way of Working Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based. Interested? Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

In this role, you will architect and drive the operating mechanisms that help Product & Technology respond effectively to incidents, reduce enterprise risk, and help provide leaders clear visibility into where attention and action are needed. You will facilitate bringing together fragmented processes and practices, help establish common standards, assist in improving communications and follow-through, and help ensure the right data reaches engineering teams, executives, and security leaders. You’ll work at the intersection of Product &Technology Operations, Engineering, and Security. You will also help connect broader enterprise risk areas, including responsible AI, application and infrastructure security, identity and access, data protection, digital supply-chain risk, shadow IT/AI, security compliance, and operational resilience - into a coherent leadership view without becoming the functional ownership of each domain. This is a high-impact individual contributor position focused on operational excellence rather than line management. We are looking for a senior hands-on specialist who thrives at the center of complex engineering and security challenges, partnering across technical teams to establish clear standards, streamline incident and vulnerability workflows, and help teams resolve critical operational risks efficiently without adding unnecessary processes. What you’ll be doing: Unify and Evolve Incident Management Mechanisms: Maintain a consistent P&T-wide incident management framework, defining clear roles, severity levels, escalation paths, and communication standards. Facilitate post-incident reviews (RCAs/post-mortems) and ensure action items are tracked to completion for systemic engineering improvements. Drive Security Incident and Vulnerability Operating Processes: Optimize intake, prioritization, escalation, and remediation workflows for security incidents and vulnerabilities alongside Engineering and Security. Build tracking views that highlight material vulnerabilities, aging trends, and exceptions requiring leadership attention. Build an Integrated View of Technology Risk: Synthesize insights across AppSec, AI governance, IAM, supply chain, data protection, and compliance into a unified, actionable view of operational risk. Identify recurring patterns across incident and vulnerability data to drive systemic fixes without duplicating team accountability. Lead Reporting, Communications, and Executive Readiness: Track core KPIs and prepare concise dashboards and briefings for the CTO, Security leadership, and board-level reviews. Run lightweight operating cadences and remove workflow friction across Engineering, Security, Product, Legal, and Compliance to keep remediations moving. What you need to bring: Deep Operational Experience: Significant experience designing, implementing, or operating incident management, technology operations, security operations, or technology risk mechanisms within a complex enterprise environment. Framework and Process Design: Proven track record of architecting and embedding durable incident management frameworks, post-incident RCA programs, communications protocols, and follow-through mechanisms across distributed engineering teams. Data and Executive Communication: Exceptional skills in helping translate complex, fragmented technical data into clear executive dashboards, narrative briefings, and board-level materials. Structured Problem Solving: Exceptional ability to assist teams in bringing order to ambiguous operational challenges, isolating systemic root causes, and building automated and durable mechanisms over manual workarounds. Poise Under Pressure: Strong situational judgment, calm demeanor, and clear analytical thinking to help navigate high-severity incidents or urgent executive escalations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Highly collaborative mindset with a track record of building trusted peer relationships across engineering, operations, security, and executive leadership. As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position. Be a changemaker You’ll enjoy: A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work A culture that celebrates performance The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard Career-defining opportunities Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled. Flexible paid time off and remote work policies Equity options, because this is your company too Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters Training opportunities to grow your skills and career Health and wellness credit so you feel your best Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook Enhanced parental leave to support growing families Fuel your growth. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. Originally posted on Himalayas

Second, you will run recruiting operations. You will also support our other in-house recruiter by taking on parts of recruiting operations for our more senior level hires. Run our ATS. Own the setup, workflows, and day-to-day operation of our applicant tracking system so our hiring process runs consistently inside it. Put AI to work. Build and maintain AI agent workflows that work well, stay current as technology changes, and reduce manual steps in hiring. Standardize and measure. Keep hiring steps and documents consistent from role to role, and manage our hiring data and dashboard so leaders can see how hiring is going. Support senior-level hiring. Partner with our other in-house recruiter on more senior level searches by supporting parts of recruiting operations. Equip hiring managers. Run the hiring intake process, support strong hiring scorecards, create interview guides, and build resources such as case scenarios or projects; train hiring managers and interview teams to hire well. Be the go-to partner. Become the person hiring managers turn to for solutions on process and recruiting operations. Build proactive pipelines. Source for the areas where we hire often, and create a sourcing plan for every active role so direct outreach starts within 24 hours of opening. Keep top talent close. Find creative ways to capture the interest of top talent and stay in touch to build a strong bench. Must-Have Qualifications · 2+ years of experience as a recruiter, filling roles from intake through offer. · Deep experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, including building out sourcing projects and outreach campaigns. · Fluency with AI tools and a strong grasp of systems and workflows, · Exceptional attention to detail, and the rigor to pursue goals and follow through until they are met. · Clear, confident communication with hiring managers, candidates, and leaders. items.description: Blackpoint Cyber is the leading provider of world-class cybersecurity threat hunting, detection and remediation technology. Founded by former National Security Agency (NSA) cyber operations experts who applied their learnings to bring national security-grade technology solutions to commercial customers around the world, Blackpoint Cyber is in hyper-growth mode, fueled by a recent $190m series C round. SUMMARY We’re hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our cloud and on-premise infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, with a focus on automation, scalability, and performance. You’ll work across cloud platform administration, container orchestration, data streaming, observability, and incident response — partnering with engineering teams to keep our systems reliable, secure, and efficient, and helping foster a culture of continuous improvement. RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Terragrunt) for automated cloud resource provisioning and orchestration. Own and optimize our AWS cloud environment, ensuring cost efficiency, security best practices, and high-availability standards. Manage and optimize Kubernetes cluster environments (Helm, ArgoCD, Istio, Kustomize) to support continuous delivery and infrastructure-as-code practices. Administer and scale data streaming infrastructure (Confluent Cloud, Apache Kafka) to support enterprise-level data processing. Deploy, configure, and maintain Redis for caching and real-time data processing. Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Alert Manager, Grafana CloudOpsGenie/PagerDuty) to ensure system reliability and performance. Facilitate controlled feature deployments and progressive rollouts through LaunchDarkly/PostHog. Partner with software development teams to ensure seamless integration of new services, applications, and features into existing infrastructure. Diagnose and resolve complex system-level issues, implementing solutions that maintain high performance and maximize uptime. Drive continuous improvement of automation tooling, operational processes, and engineering methodologies to enhance scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Stay current on emerging SRE trends and tools, andtools and help the team adopt relevant industry advancements and best practices. REQUIREMENTS 5+ years of experience in a Senior Site Reliability Engineer role or equivalent, with substantial emphasis on cloud infrastructure management and automation. Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt) for enterprise-scale deployments. Comprehensive knowledge of AWS, including designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable, resilient cloud architectures. Extensive hands-on experience with distributed data streaming (Confluent Cloud, Apache Kafka). Proven experience with Redis for caching and Amazon RDS for relational database management. Experience with enterprise search and analytics platforms (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, ChaosSearch). Proficiency designing and implementing monitoring/alerting infrastructure (Prometheus, Grafana, Alert Manager, Grafana Cloud, OpsGenie/PagerDuty). Practical experience with feature flag systems (LaunchDarkly/PostHog) for controlled release management. Extensive experience administering production-grade Kubernetes (Helm, ArgoCD, Istio); working knowledge of Kustomize. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex systems in production. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in Agile environments. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Terragrunt to manage Terraform across multiple environments. Extensive hands-on experience with distributed data streaming (Kafka). items.description: EverHelp is a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and last year we experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%. In 2026, EverHelp received 9 international workplace and employer awards. The company ranked #1 in the Top 30 Inspiring Workplaces in Europe, was named the #1 employer among European companies with 500–4,999 employees, and earned Best-in-Class recognition across 6 categories: Culture & Purpose, Leadership, Inclusion & Belonging, Wellbeing, Employee Voice, and Employee Experience. EverHelp was also named one of the 28 Best Places to Work by Business Intelligence Group — a global award recognizing companies with strong workplace cultures and outstanding employee experience. Our statement: We’re against war and unjustified aggression, We evacuated all the teammates and their families from the frontline, helped them find a new place to live and provided financial support, We provided the team with charging stations, We continue to work together for the future of Ukraine. As EverHelp continues expanding its portfolio of international customer support projects, we are looking for a Customer Support Representative (Hospitality) to join our team. In this role, you will support guests of a fast-growing hospitality project, ensuring every interaction reflects genuine care, professionalism, and a guest-first mindset. You'll help resolve booking-related inquiries, reservation issues, and other service requests while creating an outstanding customer experience across multiple communication channels. Your future responsibilities include: Providing support to guests via phone calls, email, live chat, WhatsApp, and online booking platform messages; Assisting guests with booking inquiries, reservation updates, property access, and other accommodation-related requests; Delivering exceptional customer service with a genuine hospitality mindset and a "guest-first" approach; Resolving customer inquiries efficiently while maintaining a warm, professional, and empathetic communication style; Escalating critical cases, including refund requests, legal matters, or sensitive guest complaints, to the appropriate internal teams; Accurately documenting customer interactions and case details in internal systems; Collaborating closely with teammates to ensure a seamless guest experience across all communication channels; Following internal quality standards while balancing efficiency with exceptional service. Needed experience & skills: 1–3 years of experience in Customer Support, Hospitality, or another customer-facing role; German language proficiency (B2+) and English language proficiency (B2+); Experience communicating with customers across multiple channels, including calls and written communication; Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions independently; Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset; Ability to remain calm, professional, and solution-oriented in challenging situations; High adaptability and willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-changing environment; Strong multitasking skills while maintaining high service quality; Positive attitude, resilience, and genuine enthusiasm for teamwork. Work with EverHelp is about: 20+ vacation days and 10 paid sick leaves; Ability to work fully remotely; A professional team of specialists, ready to share their expertise, along with internal communities and team activities, fosters continuous learning and development both within the team and on an individual level; Opportunity for a career growth. 32% of our teammates obtained a new role during their first year of work in our company. 86% of our Team Leads have been our Customer Support Agents in the past. Submit your resume and join our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set. We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale. About the Job Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products. You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets. You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket. Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side. In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You’ll Do Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands. Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality. Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt. Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement. Participate in on-call rotation and incident response. Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards. Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own. Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands. What We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services. 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs. Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed. Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling. A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner. A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale." Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers. Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it. Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar. Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience. Nice-to-Have Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems. Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms. Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog). AI-Native Expectations We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice: Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner. Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave. Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being. Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns. Learning & Development programs. Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers. AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Belonging Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway. #LI-Remote ____________________________________________________________________________ To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/life360-senior-software-engineer-verticals-ai-native

The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product,
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About Ritual Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies. About the role As a Distributed Systems Engineer at Ritual, you'll be instrumental in building and scaling our heterogeneous blockchain infrastructure. You'll work on innovative solutions for node specialization, consensus mechanisms, and distributed AI execution while ensuring the reliability and performance of our network. Design and implement distributed systems components for Ritual's heterogeneous compute network Develop and optimize peer-to-peer networking protocols optimized for AI model execution and blockchain consensus Build and maintain infrastructure for node monitoring, metrics collection, and system observability Architect solutions for efficient state management and synchronization across specialized nodes Collaborate with the research team to implement novel distributed systems algorithms Create robust testing frameworks for distributed system components About you Deep expertise in Go and/or Rust, with a track record of building production-grade distributed systems Strong understanding of peer-to-peer systems, networking, and messaging protocols Proven experience operating and developing blockchain nodes, with deep knowledge of node architecture and consensus mechanisms Experience optimizing high-throughput systems and implementing performance improvements at scale Advanced Linux expertise, with strong command line proficiency and system administration skills Proficiency with infrastructure orchestration tools like Kubernetes Mastery of monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus Experience designing and implementing fault-tolerant, high-performance distributed applications Strong background in system design, with the ability to make architectural decisions that balance performance, reliability, and scalability Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex distributed systems issues Ability to act quickly under high pressure scenarios and context switch at a high frequency A high level of end-to-end ownership and self-direction, with excellent communication skills Hungry, high-energy and ability to work within and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment Nice to have Familiarity with AI/ML systems and their distributed computing requirements Knowledge of cryptography and secure systems design Contributions to open-source distributed systems projects Why join us Join a passionate group of engineers, researchers, and operators on a mission to build the next generation of AI infrastructure Highly competitive compensation package, including annual discretionary bonus & optimized tax structure compared to the vast majority of web3 startups Top 1% of benefits across the web3 startup space 100% of premiums covered on highest quality healthcare Aggressive company 401k match Fully remote and/or hybrid, up to you! Participate in virtual and in-person events Much much more! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ritual-distributed-systems-engineer

items.title: Content Creator - YouTube
items.summary: Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered. Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. What we're looking for Native-level written and spoken English Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work Ability to take feedback and continuously improve Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada Nice to have Previous experience creating educational video content Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos Working at Metics Media At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work. At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos. Compensation Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada) Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. Benefits 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays 10 paid sick days per year Medical, dental, and vision coverage A 401(k) with employer contributions (US) How to apply Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

items.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
items.summary: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. What We’re Looking For: High school diploma or GED required Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment Success Factors for Working from Home Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. Adaptability : Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. Comprehensive Benefits : Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. Cell Phone Benefits : $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. Career Growth : Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors Competitive compensation and benefits package A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture Ready to Make an Impact?
