items.description: ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love. We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide. We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too. What you’ll do: Create and scale new consumer products for our network of tens of millions of children and families, building a global consumer education business. You’ll grow ClassDojo from where we are to our next order of magnitude, while deepening love for our brand. You’ll work closely with our co-founders, CTO, Head of Product, Head of Marketing, and cross-functional teams to invent and test exciting long-term ideas. You’ll work at both a strategic and tactical level, turning data, research, and intuition into products and experiences that tens of millions of children will love. You will be a match if: You have at least 4 years of experience in product management. You might be a good fit if: You’ve achieved product-market fit with new consumer products You have experience as a founder, or an equivalent level of accountability You’ve monetized consumer products, ideally subscription products or marketplaces You have a strong grasp of product strategy You have strong product intuition, and good taste You enjoy speaking with customers, and conducting qualitative user research to inform direction You have strong quantitative skills and comfort with evaluation You work well in resource-constrained environments You move faster than is comfortable—you are an instigator Your written and spoken communication is clear and concise [1] Some more context: (If you are on LinkedIn, you will not be able to access the hyperlinks below. Once you click apply, you will be directed to our career website (if you are not on there already) and will be able to access the hyperlinks) How ClassDojo Connects Parents, Students, and Teachers “ Whats New on ClassDojo 2023 ” TechCrunch Article: Second Act comes with First Profits Click here if you're interested in learning more about what we've been up to. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are happy to accommodate any disabilities or special needs. We are a distributed company, so we hire regardless of location, as long as you are willing to have significant hours overlap with one of the Americas time zones. ClassDojo takes a number of factors into consideration when determining compensation, including geographic location, experience, and skillset. Salary ranges (United States): CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT states: $188,000 - $280,000 (USD) All other states in the US: $159,800 - $238,000 (USD) #LI-Remote

items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Remote - Canada URL: http://roofr.com At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products. We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact. This position is for an existing vacancy. ***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.*** Roofr is looking for an experienced Inbound SDR with a background in driving sales and developing new business opportunities. You will lead all inbound sales inquiries and help define and improve sales processes to provide a white-glove experience for our Spanish and English-speaking customers. What You'll Get to Do: Learn about Roofr, our industry and competitors, and our value proposition Execute on a high number of daily activities (Calls, emails, social selling, etc.) Connect with and qualify inbound leads Build and establish rapport with multiple levels of buyers Understand the prospects needs and effectively communicate how Roofr will help Partner with Account Executives and collaborate on how to hand off qualified sales opportunities Document various details including use cases, purchase timeframes, and next steps Meet monthly, quarterly and annual quotas Manage customer expectations and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction Provide detailed and accurate pipeline forecasting and maintain data hygiene As part of a startup team, help define and improve sales processes, strategies, tactics, and help our customers navigate our tools with ease What You'll Bring to the Role: 2+ years of experience in a related role Able to work a PST schedule (ideally located in Pacific, Mountain, Central time zones) Self-starter, highly detail-oriented, quick learner, able to think on your feet Strong interpersonal skills and a creative problem-solving approach Ability to take feedback, make adjustments, and handle objections Comfortable on the phone, strong email writing skills and happy to handle objections Uncover potential opportunities by having conversations and setting meetings with prospective buyers Familiarity with sales tools: Hubspot, Aircall, Intercom or equivalents Roofing and/or construction experience is a plus Who You Are: Growth Mindset: Eager to develop foundational sales skills, build product and industry knowledge, and take advantage of opportunities to grow and upskill within the organization. Coachability: Open to feedback, receptive to coaching, and motivated to continuously improve. Able to take direction, apply feedback, and turn it into meaningful changes in performance. Strong Organizational Skills: Able to manage daily activities, prioritize tasks, and consistently follow through on commitments. CRM Hygiene & Accountability: Maintains accurate, up-to-date CRM records, documents prospect interactions, tracks follow-ups, and ensures pipeline activity is recorded consistently. Proactive & Self-Motivated: Takes ownership of their work, demonstrates initiative, and stays motivated to meet activity and performance goals. Communication & Relationship Building: Confident communicating with prospects, building rapport, asking thoughtful questions, and creating positive first impressions. Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, navigating rejection, learning from challenges, and adjusting their approach as needed. Compensation Range: $60,000,00 - $65,000.00 + commission CAD Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact. 🏠 What we offer (US + Canada) When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: 🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off: 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2! 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!) Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years Flexible time off 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada RRSP/401k match Generous Parental Leave policy 🤝 Perks: We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career Home office setup stipend Internet and phone allowance Remote first culture Weekly Friday paydays! 🤖 AI Notice At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you. Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too. And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️ ⚠️ Important Notice We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers . If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com . Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance! Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/roofr-sales-development-representative

items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: URL: https://interos.ai Senior Executive Assistant to the Executive Team About interos.ai interos.ai is the operational resilience company reinventing how organizations manage their supply chains and business relationships. Our breakthrough AI-powered SaaS platform transforms complex business ecosystems into a living global map, down to any single supplier, anywhere. We help companies reduce risk, prevent disruptions, and build more resilient and adaptive enterprises. The Opportunity We are seeking a highly experienced, proactive Senior Executive Assistant to serve as a trusted partner to our executive leadership team. This person will anticipate needs, manage competing priorities with minimal direction, and keep our executives organized, efficient, and focused on what matters most. The ideal candidate has supported C-level leaders in a fast-moving environment, communicates with clarity and sound judgment, and brings a strategic, solutions-oriented mindset to every interaction. Essential Functions/Duties Provide high-level, proactive administrative and strategic support to the CEO and members of the executive leadership team, anticipating needs and resolving issues befo re they escalate. Manage complex, high-volume calendars, prioritizing and scheduling internal and external meetings across time zones from HST to EST, and making sound judgment calls on competing demands. Coordinate travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries. Assist executives for meetings by gathering materials, building agendas, and capturing and distributing notes and follow-ups. Support executive operating rhythms, including leadership team meetings, board and investor preparation, and company-wide communications. Process and track expense reports, reimbursements, and purchasing requests, and monitor executive budgets as needed. Handle highly sensitive and confidential information, including board, financial, and personnel matters, with discretion and professionalism. Plan and lead internal events and offsites for executive leaders from concept through execution. Serve as a senior liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, including board members, customers, and partners. Identify, recommend, and implement improvements to administrative processes and AI-enabled tools that help executives and the team work more efficiently. Minimum Qualifications 10+ years of experience in an Executive Assistant or similar administrative role, including direct support of C-level executives. Proven ability to support multiple senior leaders concurrently. Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), virtual meeting tools (Zoom, Teams, etc.), and AI tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the presence to interact confidently with executives, board members, and external partners. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. High degree of discretion, professionalism, and integrity when handling confidential information. Prior exposure to supporting cross-functional, distributed teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience in a technology or high-growth startup environment. Additional Information Location: Remote Compensation: The base salary range is $150,000–$180,000. The range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual salary will be commensurate with skills, experience, certifications or licenses, and other relevant factors. In addition, this role will be eligible to participate in either the annual performance bonus or commission program, determined by the nature of the position. FLSA Status: Exempt To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/interos-senior-executive-assistant-to-the-executive-team

These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. How to apply Please submit your application on our website: https://join.meticsmedia.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metics-media-content-creator-youtube

Help strengthen democracy through voter education and civic technology Lead mission-driven editorial initiatives with national impact Collaborate with passionate professionals across journalism, technology, product, and communications Expand your leadership and editorial management experience Build your portfolio while contributing to an innovative nonprofit organization Position Details Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred) Time Commitment: Approximately 5-10 hours per week Compensation: Volunteer Position About WeVote WeVote is a nonpartisan, nonprofit civic technology organization dedicated to helping voters make informed choices. Through innovative digital tools, trusted voter information, and community engagement, we work to increase participation in every election. * Fraud and phishing warning * Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wevote-managing-editor-volunteer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , used on more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, we're looking for a creative, experienced Content Marketing Lead who knows how to turn great content into real business results. AI has changed how we create content, and we embrace it. But great content still needs someone who understands customers, spots opportunities, tells compelling stories, and knows what actually works. We're looking for someone who combines excellent writing skills, creativity, business understanding, and hands-on execution to make smart decisions, turn ideas into compelling content, attract customers, and help our business grow. What You'll Do You'll have the freedom to shape our content marketing, experiment with new ideas, and see the impact of your work. Create content that makes a difference : write engaging website pages, articles, emails, and campaigns that attract and connect with customers. Own the content direction : identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring ideas from concept to publication. Make the most of AI : use AI tools to research, create, improve, and scale content while keeping quality high. Grow our visibility : improve SEO and AI-search presence (GEO/AEO) to help more people discover our products. Build connections : collaborate with partners, customers, and product experts to create content that stands out. Turn insights into results : track performance, experiment, learn what works, and continuously improve. You'll work closely with our CEO, product teams, and marketing colleagues, with plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life. What We're Looking For You're an excellent writer and experienced content marketer who can make even complex technical products interesting and easy to understand. You've owned successful content marketing projects and can show the results of your work. You are hands-on with SEO, email marketing, and content distribution , and know how they contribute to business growth. You're AI-native, using AI tools confidently to create better content and work more effectively. You understand customers, products, and competition , and can turn these insights into compelling content. You're creative, proactive, and independent . You enjoy making decisions, trying new things, and taking responsibility for results. You have experience with SaaS, software, WordPress, or other technical products . Why Join Us? We're a profitable, self-funded software company with a global customer base and a fully remote team. You'll have the chance to own content marketing for an established product, work directly with decision-makers, experiment with the latest AI tools, and make a visible impact on our business. We value great ideas, initiative, and people who enjoy turning opportunities into results. What We Offer 100% remote work with an international team. Paid time off and national holidays to recharge. Body and Mind Movement (BAMM) program to support your hobbies and well-being. Computer budget for a comfortable workspace. Kindle and access to our company Amazon account. Smart, supportive, and self-driven colleagues from around the world. Freedom to experiment, grow, and make a real impact. Love creating content, exploring what AI can do, and seeing your ideas turn into real results? We'd love to meet you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-content-marketing-lead

items.title: Founding Account Executive
items.summary: Headquarters: URL: https://careers.mozaiq.com About LiftPilot LiftPilot is an AI-powered website personalization platform for B2B companies. We help marketing and growth teams give every visitor a tailored website experience, turning more traffic into engagement, qualified pipeline and conversions. The product is built, enterprise-grade and in the
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: URL: https://careers.mozaiq.com About LiftPilot LiftPilot is an AI-powered website personalization platform for B2B companies. We help marketing and growth teams give every visitor a tailored website experience, turning more traffic into engagement, qualified pipeline and conversions. The product is built, enterprise-grade and in the market. We’re live with our first pilots and the results so far have been exceptional. The role LiftPilot is early enough that how we sell is still an open question, and you’d be the person answering it — figuring out who bites, what lands, which deals are worth chasing and which aren’t. You won’t be doing that from a standing start: the founding team is deep in this market, so the product knowledge, the context and the second opinions are all a message away. You’d run the whole cycle yourself, target list through to signed. The pipeline you work is the pipeline you build, and what you learn building it is what LiftPilot’s sales motion becomes. If you want a process to follow, this isn’t it. If you want to be the reason there’s a process at all, let’s talk. What you'll do Build your own target list and book every meeting through your own outreach: email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Sell to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen and growth leaders at B2B companies. Run discovery calls, and prepare a tailored demo for each first meeting. Help your champion make the case internally, and position LiftPilot against existing tools, agencies and internal builds. Negotiate and close new business, and set each new customer up for a smooth start. Keep an accurate, honest pipeline in the CRM. Bring what you hear from buyers back into the product. What you need 4+ years as a quota-carrying Account Executive closing new business in B2B SaaS, with a record of hitting your number. Selling to marketing leaders. You've sold to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen or growth leaders, not IT or finance. MarTech sales experience. You’ve sold marketing technology, such as website personalization, ABM, CRO, advertising, analytics or content tools. Early-stage experience. You've carried a number at an early-stage company, ideally as one of its first two salespeople. Self-sourced pipeline. Most of your pipeline came from your own outreach, and you can walk us through how you built it. Selling without proof. You've closed deals with no case studies or references to point to. Strong writing. You write cold emails that get replies. Organized and self-directed. You plan your week, follow up without being chased, and write down what's working. Curiosity about the product. You want to understand how it works, not just pitch it. You Close. You push deals to a decision rather than letting them drift. You’re comfortable asking for the signature, chasing the fourth follow-up, and naming the thing that’s blocking a deal instead of waiting it out. Nice to have Experience selling website personalization, ABM, CRO or experimentation platforms. Experience selling AI products. Experience in a founder-led sales team. Experience navigating buying committees in mid-market and enterprise deals. This role isn't for you if You need an SDR, a territory or an account list to hit your number. Most of your past pipeline came from inbound or leads you were handed. You're looking for a VP or Head of Sales title right away. What we offer Base salary: $100,000 to $125,000 USD, depending on experience. Uncapped commission on every deal you close. Fully remote. Direct access to the founder, product team, and to have real influence on how we sell. Room to grow as the sales team grows. Our hiring process 1. Intro call 2. Conversation with our founder 3. Pitch us. Run us through a pitch for your current company’s product, the way you’d do it on a real first call. 4. Paid take-home exercise We give you a list of companies; you show us how you'd prioritize them and draft your first outreach. 5. Team session. Walk us through your exercise, then work through a few real buyer scenarios with the team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mozaiq-founding-account-executive

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.
